references.title: O Lord our God hear Thou our pray'r

lines: O Lord our God hear Thou our pray'r
In this Thy house on this Thy day
Sweet is Thy rest, O Lord my God
But there's a greater rest above
Thus our thirsty soul now desire
No more fatigue, no more labour
Nor sin, nor death shall reach the place
The voice of pain shall not sound there
No rude alarms of ranging foes
The daylight will not be dark there
Dawn on this realms of world of pain
With joy we shall walk path of joy
And sleep in death to rest with Lord.

title: O Lord our God hear Thou our pray'r

lines: Faith of our fathers! Living still,
In spite of dungeon, fire, and sword;
O how our hearts beat high with joy
Whene'er we hear that glorious word!
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to Thee till death.
Our fathers, chained in prisons dark,
Were still in heart and conscience free;
How sweet would be their children's fate,
If they like them, could die for Thee!
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to Thee till death.
Faith of our fathers! We will strive
To win all nations unto Thee
And through the truth that comes from God
Mankind shall then be truly free:
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to Thee till death.
Faith of our fathers! We will love
Both friend and foe in all our strife,
And preach Thee, too, as love knows how
By kindly words and virtuous life:
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to Thee till death.

references.title: God Who Spoke in the Beginning

lines: God who spoke in the beginning, Forming rock and shaping spar, Set all life and growth in motion, Earthly world and distant star; He who calls the earth to order Is the ground of what we are.
God who spoke thro` men and nations, Thro` events long past and gone, Showing still today His purpose, Speaks supremely through His Son; He who calls the earth to order Gives His word and it is done.
God whose speech becomes incarnate - Christ is servant, Christ is Lord - Calls us to a life of service, Heart and will to action stirred; He who uses man`s obedience Has the first and final word.

title: God Who Spoke in the Beginning

references.title: Christ Jesus lay in death's strong bands

lines: Christ Jesus lay in death's strong bands,
But now at God's right hand he stands
And brings us life from heaven;
And sing to God right thankfully
It was a strange and dreadful strife
The reign of death was ended;
That death is swallowed up by death,
His sting is lost for ever. Hallelujah!
Here the true Paschal Lamb we see,
Whom God so freely gave us;
He died on the accursed tree—
So strong his love!—to save us.
See, his blood doth mark our door;
Faith points to it, death passes o'er,
And Satan cannot harm us. Hallelujah!
So let us keep the festival
Christ is himself the Joy of all,
The Sun that warms and lights us.
By his grace he doth impart
The night of sin is ended. Hallelujah!
Then let us feast this joyful day
On Christ, the Bread of heaven;
The Word of grace hath purged away
Christ alone our souls will feed,
He is our meat and drink indeed;
Faith lives upon no other. Hallelujah!

title: Christ Jesus lay in death's strong bands

references.title: The Saviour lives, no more to die;

lines: The Saviour lives, no more to die;
He lives our Head, enthroned on high;
He lives triumphant o'er the grave;
He lives to still His people's fears;
He lives to wipe away their tears;
He lives their mansions to prepare;
He lives to bring them safely there.
The chief of sinners He receives;
His saints He loves, and never leaves;
He'll guard us safe from every ill,
Then let our souls in Him rejoice
And sing His praise with cheerful voice;
Our doubts and fears for ever gone,
For Christ is on the Father's throne.

title: The Saviour lives, no more to die;

lines: To suffer, once to earth He came,
And now He's crowned in heaven.
Rememb'ring this we break the bread,
Let each by faith Thy body see
Our theme of joy and wonder here,
Our souls to cleave to Thee!
And ever in our hearts remain
To Thee my all I owe;
Thy sovereign bounty is the spring
Thy sovereign bounty is the spring
More praise than I can give.
More praise than I can give.
Thy love demands a thankful heart;
Thy love demands a thankful heart;
Let every word and each desire
and all my days be Thine.
Let every word and each desire
and all my days be Thine.

references.title: I am coming to the cross,

lines: But God forbid that I should glory, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus. Gal.6:14.
I am coming to the cross,
I am poor and weak and blind;
I am counting all but dross;
I am trusting, Lord in Thee,
di Humbly at the cross I bow,
Save me, Jesus, save me now.
Now I feel the blood applied;
I am prostrate in the dust,
Jesus comes! He fills my soul!
I am every white made whole:

title: I am coming to the cross,

lines: To the service of the Lord;
Make your lives for Him more fitted,
Tune your hearts with one accord.
Come into His courts with gladness,
Turn away from sin and sadness,
Of your time and talents give ye,
They are gifts from God above;
To be used by Christians freely
Come again to serve the Saviour,
Tithes and off’rings with you bring.
In your work, with Him find favor,
And with joy His praises sing.
God’s command to love each other
Of His love that is divine;
On the cross sins were forgiven;
Joy and peace are fully thine.
All who on Christ’s name believe;
Grace and love you will receive.
For His grace give Him the glory,
For the Spirit and the Word,
Till mankind His name has heard.
Dispel the darkness from our minds,
Give us to lie with humble hope
And kindle in our breasts the flames
And to our wond'ring view, reveal
To pour fresh life in ev'ry part,
Then we shall know and praise and love

references.title: Rock of Ages, cleft for me,

lines: In the secret of his tabernacle shall He hide me. Ps. 27:5
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide my self in Thee,
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy river side which flowed
Be of sin the double cure,
Cleanse my from its guilt and power,
Not the labours of my hands
Could my zeal no respite know,
Could my tears for ever flow,
All for sin could not atone;
Thou must save, and thou alone,
Nothing in my hand I bring,
Simply to Thy Cross I cling,
Naked, come to Thee for dress;
Helpless, look to Thee for grace;
Foul, I to the fountain fly;
Wash me, Saviour, or I die.
While I draw this fleeting breath
When my eyelids close in death,
When I soar to worlds unknown
See Thee on Thy judgement throne,
di Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Le me hide myself in Thee

title: Rock of Ages, cleft for me,

references.title: Jesus, What a Friend for Sinners

lines: Jesus! what a Friend for sinners! Jesus! Lover of my soul; Friends may fail me, foes assail me, He, my Savior, makes me whole.
Jesus! what a Strength in weakness! Let me hide myself in Him. Tempted, tried, and sometimes failing, He, my Strength, my victory wins.
Jesus! what a Help in sorrow! While the billows over me roll, Even when my heart is breaking, He, my Comfort, helps my soul.
Jesus! I do now receive Him, [or Jesus! I do now adore Him,] More than all in Him I find. He hath granted me forgiveness, I am His, and He is mine.
Hallelujah! what a Savior! Hallelujah! what a Friend! Saving, helping, keeping, loving, He is with me to the end.

title: Jesus, What a Friend for Sinners

references.title: Tis we, O Lord, whom Thou hast shown

lines: Tis we, O Lord, whom Thou hast shown
We, who forgiving love have known,
Thy presence called for Israel's praise,
And when in death they met their gaze,
What songs of glorious triumph rose.
And we have known redemption, Lord,
From bondage worse than theirs by far;
Sin held us by a stronger cord,
Yet by Thy mercy free we are.
O blessed Lord! Thy groans and tears,
Thy death the power of darkness broke;
Bursting the chains we wore for years
It freed us from the iron yoke.
Thy people from the deep couldst bring;
The glorious triumph all Thine own:
Thy Name, Thy might, Thy grace, we sing.

title: Tis we, O Lord, whom Thou hast shown

references.title: Light of the world, shine on our souls;

lines: Light of the world, shine on our souls;
And while we meet to learn Thy truth
May we its riches, power, and depth,
Its joyful news of saving grace
Thus may Thy word be dearer still,
And as it richly dwells within,

title: Light of the world, shine on our souls;

references.title: O Saviour, bless us ere we go,

lines: For the Lord shall be thine everlasting light. Isa. 60:20.
O Saviour, bless us ere we go,
Thy word into our minds instill,
And make our lukewarm hearts to glow
With lowly love and fervent will,
O gentle Jesus, be our light.
The day is gone, its hours have run;
And Thou has taken count of all,
The scanty triumphs grace hath won,
The broken vow, the frequent fall,
Forgive us, Lord; yea, give us joy,
That only long to be like Thee.
Labour is sweet, for Thou hast toil'd,
And care is light, for Thou has cared:
Let not our works with self be soil'd
For all we love, the poor, the sad,
The sinful, unto Thee we call;
Oh let Thy mercy make us glad;
Thou art our Saviour, and our all.
O Saviour, bless us; night is come,
Thy holy Presence with us be,
Good angels watch about our home,
And we are one day nearer Thee.

title: O Saviour, bless us ere we go,

lines: In weakness to my God I cling,
Though foes be strong I calmly sing,
The strength of God's almighty arm
Doth shield my soul from every harm,
Unshaken on my God I lean,
His mighty love ne'er cold shall wax,
Nor shall His pow'rful grasp relax,
Ye slaves of sin and hell,
Ye who have sold for nought
The year of jubilee is come!
The year of jubilee is come!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The year of jubilee is come!
The year of jubilee is come!

references.title: Wake, Awake for the Night Is Flying

lines: Wake, awake, for night is flying, The watchmen on the heights are crying, Awake, Jerusalem, arise! Midnight`s solemn hour is tolling, His chariot wheels are nearer rolling, He comes; prepare, ye virgins wise. Rise up with willing feet Go forth, the Bridegroom meet; Alleluia! Bear through the night your well-trimmed light, Speed forth to join the marriage rite.

Zion hears the watchmen singing, Her heart with deep delight is springing, She wakes, she rises from her gloom; Forth her Bridegroom comes, all-glorious, In grace arrayed, by truth victorious; Her Star is risen, her Light is come! All hail, incarnate Lord, Our crown, and our reward! Alleluia! We haste along, in pomp and song, And gladsome join the marriage throng.

Lamb of God, the heavens adore Thee, And men and angels sing before Thee, With harp and cymbal`s clearest tone. By the pearly gates in wonder We stand, and swell the voice of thunder, That echoes round Thy dazzling throne. No vision ever brought, No ear hath ever caught, Such bliss and joy; We raise the song, we swell the throng, To praise Thee ages all along.

title: Wake, Awake for the Night Is Flying

lines: My Conqu'ror, with what joy divine
I love thy yoke to wear,
Within the limits of thy love

And ask of thee the road.
My Guardian and my Guide divine,

And with thee thy glad captive bring

references.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus

lines: What a friend we have in Jesus,
all our sins and griefs to bear!
O what peace we often forfeit,
O what needless pain we bear,
all because we do not carry
take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful
who will all our sorrows share?
take it to the Lord in prayer.
Are we weak and heavy laden,
cumbered with a load of care?
take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer!
In his arms he'll take and shield thee;
thou wilt find a solace there.

title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus

references.title: Great Our Joy as Now We Gather

lines: Great our joy as now we gather
Where the Master makes us one:
Where we worship God the Father
Thro’ the Spirit of His Son.
All who search for His church
Find it where His will is done.
Precious is the tie that binds us
To our God when faith grows cold;
Precious all that now reminds us
He is still our safe stronghold.
Here the Shepherd has His fold.
May we learn from Christ’s example
How to use this house of prayer:
He who loved and cleansed His temple
Wants us all to worship there.
God the Son shuts out none:
In His Kingdom all may share.
Lord, inspire us with Your vision
Of a world which must be won!

title: Great Our Joy as Now We Gather

lines: God Himself is with us; Let us all adore Him, And with awe appear before Him. God is here within us; Soul, in silence fear Him, Humbly, fervently draw near Him. Now His own who have known God, In worship lowly, Yield their spirits wholly.

Come, abide within me; Let my soul, like Mary, Be Thine earthly sanctuary. Come, indwelling Spirit, With transfigured splendor; Love and honor will I render. Where I go here below, Let me bow before Thee, Know Thee and adore Thee.

Gladly we surrender Earth`s deceitful treasures, Pride of life and sinful pleasures: Gladly, Lord, we offer Thine to be forever, Soul and life and each endeavor. Thou alone shall be known Lord of all our being, Life`s true way decreeing.

All glory, laud, and honor, to thee, Redeemer, King, to whom the lips of children made sweet hosannas ring. Thou art the King of Israel, thou David`s royal Son, who in the Lord`s name comest, the King and Blessed One.

The company of angels are praising thee on high, and we with all creation in chorus make reply. The people of the Hebrews with psalms before thee went; our prayer and praise and anthems before thee we present.

To thee, before thy passion, they sang their hymns of praise; to thee, now high exalted, our melody we raise. Thou didst accept their praises; accept the prayers we bring, who in all good delightest, thou good and gracious King.
Nor toucheth He our hearts in vain;
We praise, we praise the Lord.
And faith takes up the happy strain
Our joy is in the Lord.
"Stand fast in Christ!" ah! yet again
Our best endeavours are in vain,
"Clean every whit!" Thou saidst it, Lord;
Thine, surely, is a faithful word,
For ever be the glory given
To Thee, O Lamb of God!
No joy for us, in earth or heaven,
We owe not to Thy blood.

references.title: Come, Holy Ghost, our souls inspire

lines: For the fruit of the spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth Eph 5:19
Come, Holy Ghost, our souls inspire
Who dost thy sevenfold gifts impart,
Is comfort, life, and fire of love;
The dullness of our blinded sight,
Anoint and cheer our soiled face
With the abundance of thy grace;
di Keep far our foes; give peace at home;
Where thou art Guide no ill can come.
Teach us to know the Father, Son,
And thee of Both, to be but One,
That through the ages all along
And this may be our endless song,

title: Come, Holy Ghost, our souls inspire

lines: Lord, speak to me, that I may speak
In living echoes of Thy tone;
As Thou hast sought, so let me seek
Thy erring children lost and lone.
O lead me, Lord, that I may lead
The wandering and the wavering feet;
O feed me, Lord, that I may feed
Thy hungering ones with manna sweet.
O strengthen me, that while I stand
Firm on the Rock, and strong in Thee,
I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestlers with the troubled sea.
I'm glad I know that Christ shall reign
And come to earth in clouds again,
And to my Saviour praises bring
I hope to see Him on the throne
When He shall come to claim his own,
I'll sing while mounting through the air,
To meet my Father's children there,
Come on, dear friends, let's mend our pace,
We soon shall see Him face to face,
The Bride shall reign, the Bridegroom too,
Let's keep the blessed prize in view,

references.title: Christ Is the World’s True Light

lines: Christ is the world’s true light,
And night is turned to day.
When Christ is throned as Lord,
One Lord, in one great name
Unite us all who own Thee,

Come, Prince of Peace, and reign.

references.title: Jesus, Thy boundless love to me

lines: Jesus, Thy boundless love to me
No thought can reach, no tongue declare;
O knit my thankful heart to Thee,
And reign without a rival there:
Thine wholly, Thine alone, I am,
Be Thou alone my constant flame.
O grant that nothing in my soul
May dwell but Thy pure love alone;
O may Thy love possess me whole,
My joy, my treasure, and my crown;
Strange flames far from my heart remove;
My every act, word, though, be love.
O Love, how cheering is Thy ray;
All pain before Thy presence flies,
O Jesus, nothing may I see,
Nothing desire, or seek, but Thee.
Dauntless to the high prize aspire;
This holy flame, this heav'nly fire;
And day and night be all my care
To guide the sacred treasure there.

lines: Day of judgement, day of wonders!
See the Lord in glory nearing,
You who long for His appearing,
Then shall say, “This God is mine!”
Own me in that day as Thine.
At His call the dead awaken,
Rise to life from earth and sea!

But to those who have confessed
Loved and served the Lord below,
He will say, "Come near, ye blessed,
Shall My love and glory know.”

title: Day of Judgement, Day of Wonders!

lines: Just as I am, without one plea, but that thy blood was shed for me, and that thou bidst me come to thee, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, and waiting not to rid my soul of one dark blot, to thee whose blood can cleanse each spot, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, though tossed about with many a conflict, many a doubt, fightings and fears within, without, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind; sight, riches, healing of the mind, yea, all I need in thee to find, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, thou wilt receive, wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve; because thy promise I believe, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, thy love I own hath broken every barrier down; now, to be thine, and thine alone, O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

references.title: Day of judgement! Day of wonders!

lines: The hour is coming, in which all that
are in graves shall hear his voice. John 5:28
Day of judgement! Day of wonders!
How the summons, how the summons
See the judge, our nature wearing,
Ye who love the Lord's appearing
Then shall say, "This God is mine!"
Own me on that day as thine.
At His call the dead awaken,
Rise to life from earth and sea;
All the pow'rs of nature, shaken,
At his call prepare to flee:
What will then become of thee?
The devil that deceives thee now
When these riches shall pass away
It shall find thee in the fire
Of thy place in burning hell.
Let this word thy counsel be
The day of the Lord comes quickly
Then our tears will turn to joy.
When the world shall be on fire.

title: Day of judgement! Day of wonders!

references.title: He leadeth me, O blessed thought!

lines: He leadeth me, O blessed thought!
O words with heavenly comfort fraught!
Whate'er I do, where'er I be,
Still 'tis God's hand that leadeth me.
By waters still, o'er troubled sea,
Still 'tis His hand that leadeth me.
Lord, I would clasp Thy hand in mine,
Since 'tis my God that leadeth me.
And when my task on earth is done,
When, by Thy grace, the vict'ry's won
E'en death's cold wave I will not flee
If God through Jordan leadeth me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He leadeth me! He leadeth me!
By His own hand He leadeth me.

title: He leadeth me, O blessed thought!

references.title: Just as I am, without one plea (tune 1)

lines: Just as I am, without one plea
But that thy blood was shed for me,
And that thou bidd'st me come to thee,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark blot,
To thee, whose blood can cleanse each spot,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind,
Yea, all I need, in thee to find,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am! thou wilt receive,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.
Just as I am! thy love unknown
Now, to be thine, yea, thine alone,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

title: Just as I am, without one plea (tune 1)

references.title: O Christ, Our Hope, Our Heart's Desire

lines: O Christ, our hope, our heart's desire,
Creator of the world art Thou,
How vast the mercy and the love
Which laid our sins on Thee,
And led Thee to a cruel death
But now the bonds of death are burst,
And Thou art on Thy Father's throne,
O Christ, be Thou our lasting joy,
Our only glory may it be

title: O Christ, Our Hope, Our Heart's Desire

lines: The golden morning is fast approaching; Jesus soon will come To take his faithful and happy children to their promised home
The gospel summons will soon be carried to the nations round; The Bridegroom then will cease to tarry and the trumpet sound.
Attended by all the shining angels, Down the flaming sky the Judge will come, and will take his people where they will not die.
The lov`d of earth who have long been parted, Meet in that glad day; The tears of those who are broken hearted shall be wiped away.
O, we see the gleams of the golden morning piercing thro` this night of gloom! O, see the gleams of the golden morning that will burst the tomb.

references.title: All people that on earth do dwell

lines: All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice;
Him serve with fear, his praise forthtell,
Come ye before him and rejoice.
The Lord ye know is God indeed;
Without our aid he did us make;
We are his folk, he doth us feed,
And for his sheep he doth us take.
O enter then his gates with praise,
Approach with joy his courts unto;
Praise, laud, and bless his name always,
For it is seemly so to do.
For why? the Lord our God is good,
His mercy is for ever sure;
His truth at all times firmly stood,
And shall from age to age endure.

title: All people that on earth do dwell

references.title: Blessed hope that in Jesus is given

lines: Blessed hope that in Jesus is given
In our sorrow to cheer and sustain,
That soon with our Saviour in heaven
We shall meet with our loved ones again.
Blessed hope in the Word God has spoken,
All our peace by that Word we obtain;
And as sure as God's Word was ne'er broken
We shall meet with our loved ones again.
Blessed hope! how it shines in our sorrow
Like the star over Bethlehem's plain,
That it may be, with Him, ere the morrow
We shall meet with our loved ones again.
Blessed hope! the bright star of the morning
That shall herald His coming to reign;
O the glory that waits its fair dawning
When we meet with our loved ones again.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We shall meet with our loved ones again.

title: Blessed hope that in Jesus is given

lines: Fairest of all the earth beside,
Chiefest of all unto Thy bride,
Fulness divine in Thee I see,
Has won my heart from me,
And died to set me free,
Granting the sinner life and peace,
Shedding His blood to make us free,
Has won my heart from me,
And died to set me free,
Giving the gifts obtained for men,
Pouring out love beyond our ken,
Has won my heart from me,
And died to set me free,
Comfort of all my earthly way,
Jesus, I'll meet Thee some sweet day;
Centre of glory Thee I'll see,
Has won my heart from me,
And died to set me free,
Cause me to hear Thy loving kindness in the morning, for in Thee do I trust. Cause me to know they way where-in I shall walk for I lift up my soul to Thee. Amen
Now is the mighty Captive freed,
With him is risen the ransomed seed,
He lives, to die no more,
He lives, the sinner's cause to plead,
Whose curse and shame he bore.
Up to the Courts of heaven with speed
Join, all ye bright celestial choirs,
Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
his kingdom spread from shore to shore,
till moons shall wax and wane no more.
To Jesus endless prayer be made,
and endless praises crown his head;
his name like sweet perfume shall rise
People and realms of every tongue
dwell on his love with sweetest song;
their early blessings on his name.
all prisoners leap and loose their chains;
and all who suffer want are blest.
Let every creature rise and bring
and earth repeat the loud amen!

references.title: Hail Him the King of Glory

lines: Tell it to every kindred and nation, Tell it far and near; Earth`s darkest night will fade with the dawning, Jesus will soon appear.
Nations again in strife and commotion, Warnings by the way; Signs in the heavens, unerring omens, Herald the glorious day.
Children of God look up with rejoicing; Shout and sing His praise; Bless`d are they who, waiting and watching, Look for the dawning rays.
Hail Him the King of glory, Once the Lamb for sinners slain; Tell, tell the wondrous story, `Jesus comes to reign.`

title: Hail Him the King of Glory

lines: This question comes to you and me!
Tell me, what shall your answer be?
Leaving the strait and narrow way,
Sad will their final ending be,
Trust in the Savior’s grace and pow'r.
Then will your joyous answer be,

references.title: My God my Father, while I stray,

lines: My God my Father, while I stray,
Far from my home, on life's rough way,
Oh teach me from my heart to say,
Though dark my path and sad my lot,
Let me be still and murmur not;
Or breathe the pray'r divinely taught,
What though in lonely grief I sigh,
For friends belov'd no longer nigh,
If Thou should'st call me to resign
What most I prize, it ne'er was mine;
I only yield Thee what is Thine;
Let but my fainting heart be blest
With Thy sweet Spirit for its guest,
My God, to Thee I leave the rest,
Renew my will from day to day,
Blend it with Thine, and take away
All that now makes it hard to say,
Then, when on earth I breathe no more,
Thy pray'r, oft mix'd with tears before,
I'll sing upon a happier shore,

title: My God my Father, while I stray,

references.title: Saviour, like a Shepherd lead us

lines: Saviour, like a Shepherd lead us,
Much we need thy tend'rest care;
In thy pleasant pastures feed us,
For our use thy folds prepare:
Thou hast bought us, thine we are.
We are thine; do thou befriend us,
Be the Guardian of our way;
Keep thy flock, from sin defend us,
Seek us when we go astray:
Hear the children when they pray.
Thou hast promised to receive us,
Poor and sinful though we be;
Thou hast mercy to relieve us,
Grace to cleanse, and pow'r to free:
Let us early turn to thee.
Early let us seek thy favor;
Early let us do thy will;
With thy love our bosoms fill
Thou hast loved us, love us still.

title: Saviour, like a Shepherd lead us

lines: Behold what manner of love that He loved us. 1 Joh. 3:1
Sinner, O won't you believe if?
Down from the dawn of creation
E'en from the dawn of creation
For all the pure and bless
Rest in those mansions above us
With those who've gone on before us

references.title: Are the world of men seeking for

lines: Therefore be ye ready for in such an hour as ye
think not the son of man cometh. Matt. 24:44
Are the world of men seeking for
If the world hand heaven passes
As it was in the day of Noa
So cometh the Son of Man
Therefore let us all be prepar'd
Blessed is He that is waiting
Whom the Lord shall found watching
And he will make him the captain
How mighty the joy would be
Husband, wife, make him the captain
Lord Jesus Christ, count us worthy
That above we may join with them
To praise Thee for ever more.

title: Are the world of men seeking for

references.title: Blest be the tie that binds our hearts (tune 1)
Blest be the tie that binds our hearts (tune 2)

lines: Blest be the tie that binds
Our fears, our hopes, our aims, are one,
And often for each other flows
But we shall still be joined in heart,
And longs to see the day.
And sin, we shall be free;
And perfect love and friendship reign

title: Blest be the tie that binds our hearts (tune 1)

lines: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him, for He is thy health and salvation
All ye who hear, Now to His temple draw near;
Praise to the Lord, who o'er all things so wondrously reigneth,
Shelters thee under His wings yea, so gently sustaineth!
Hast Thou not seen How thy desires e'er have been
Praise to the Lord, who doth prosper thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and mercy shall daily attend thee;
Ponder anew What the Almighty can do,
If with His love He befriend thee.
Praise to the Lord, who with marvelous wisdom hath made thee!
Decked thee with health, and with loving hand guided and stayed thee;
Hath not He brought thee relief,
Spreading His wings for thee to shade thee!
Praise to the Lord! O let all that is in me adore - Him!
All that hath life and breath, come now with praises before Him!
Gladly for aye we adore Him

references.title: Lead, kindly Light, amid t he encircling gloom,

lines: In the daytime also He led them with a cloud and
all the night with a light of fire. Ps. 78:14
Lead, kindly Light, amid t he encircling gloom,
The night is dark, and I am far from home;
Keep Thou my feet; I do not ask to see
The distant scene-one step enough for me.
I was not ever thus, nor pray'd that Thou
I lov'd to choose and see my path, but now
I loved the garish day, and, spite of fears,
Pride ruled my will; remember not past years.
So long Thy pow'r hath bless'd me, sure it still
O'er moor and fen, o'er crag and torrent, till
And with the morn those angel faces smile
Which I have lov'd long since, and lost awhile.

title: Lead, kindly Light, amid t he encircling gloom,

references.title: For the Bread Which You Have Broken

lines: For the bread which you have broken,
for the wine which you have poured,
for the words which you have spoken,
now we give you thanks, O Lord.
By this pledge that you do love us,
by your gift of peace restored,
by your call to heaven above us,
hallow all our lives, O Lord.
With our sainted ones in glory
may the church that's waiting for you
In your service, Lord, defend us,
in our hearts keep watch and ward;
in the world where you have sent us,
let your kingdom come, O Lord.

title: For the Bread Which You Have Broken

references.title: King of my life, I crown Thee now,

lines: King of my life, I crown Thee now,
Lest I forget Thy thorn-crowned brow,
Lest I forget Thy love for me
Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid
Angels in robes of light arrayed
Let me, like Mary, through the gloom
Come with a gift to Thee
Show to me now the empty tomb
Fill me, O Lord, with Thy desire
For all who know not Thee
Then touch my lips with holy fire

title: King of my life, I crown Thee now,

references.title: Let us with a gladsome mind

lines: Let us with a gladsome mind,
Praise the Lord, for he is kind:
Let us blaze his name abroad,
For of gods he is the God:
Filled the new-made world with light:
All things living he doth feed;
His full hand supplies their need:
He his chosen race did bless
He hath with a piteous eye

title: Let us with a gladsome mind

references.title: Sing A New Song to the Lord

lines: Sing a new song to the Lord,
Rejoice in His triumph and tell of His power.
O sing a new song to the Lord.
Now to the ends of the earth
And still He remembers His mercy and truth,
Unchanging in love to His own.
Sing a new song and rejoice.
Let voices in chorus with trumpet and horn,
Resound for the joy of the Lord.
Join with the hills and the sea,
In judgement and justice He comes to the earth .
O sing a new song to the Lord.

title: Sing A New Song to the Lord

lines: Sing them over again to me,
let me more of their beauty see,
Christ, the blessed one, gives to all
sinner, list to the loving call,
offer pardon and peace to all,
where a mother laid her baby
in a manger for his bed;
He came down to earth from heaven
who is God and Lord of all,
and his shelter was a stable,
and his cradle was a stall.
With the poor, the scorned, the lowly
lived on earth our Savior holy.
day by day, like us he grew;
he was little, weak, and helpless,
tears and smiles like us he knew;
and he feeleth for our sadness,
and he shareth in our gladness.
And our eyes at last shall see him,
for that child so dear and gentle
is our Lord in heaven above;
and he leads his children on
to the place where he is gone.

references.title: Stand up, stand up for Jesus!

lines: Wherefore take unto the whole armour of God. Eph. 6:13
Stand up, stand up for Jesus!
Stand up, stand up for Jesus!
Ye that are men, now serve Him
Stand up, stand up for Jesus!
The arm of flesh will fail you;
Ye dare not trust your own,
Stand up, stand up for Jesus!
di The strife will not be long;
This day the noise of battle,
A crown of life shall be;
He with the King of Glory

title: Stand up, stand up for Jesus!

lines: Ride on! ride on in majesty!
Hark, all the tribes hosanna cry;
O Saviour meek, pursue Thy road
With palms and scattered garments strowed.
Ride on! ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die;
O Christ, Thy triumphs now begin
O’er captive death and conquered sin.
Ride on! ride on in majesty!
The winged squadrons of the sky
Look down with sad and wondering eyes
Ride on! ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die;
Bow Thy meek head to mortal pain,
Then take, O God, Thy power and reign.
I would be, dear Savior, wholly Thine; Teach me how, teach me how; I would do Thy will, O Lord, not mine; Help me, help me now.
What is worldly pleasure, wealth or fame, Without Thee, without Thee? I will leave them all for Thy dear Name, This my wealth shall be.
As I cast earth`s transient joys behind, Come Thou near, come Thou near; In Thy presence all in all I find, `Tis my comfort here.
Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, Wholly Thine, this is my vow; Wholly Thine, wholly Thine, Wholly Thine, O Lord, just now.

references.title: Yield not to temptation, for yielding is sin

lines: Neither give place to the devil. Eph.4:27.
Yield not to temptation, for yielding is sin
Each victory will help you some other to win
Fight manfully onward, dark passions subdue,
Look ever to Jesus, He'll carry you through,
Ask, the Saviour to help you,
He is willing to aid you,
Shun evil companions, bad language disdain
God's name hold in reverence, nor take it in vain,
Be thoughtful and earnest, kind hearted and true,
Look ever to Jesus, He'll carry you through.
To him that o'er cometh, God giveth a crown.
Through faith we shall conquer, though often cast down,
He who is our Saviour, our strength will renew
Look ever to Jesus, He'll carry you through.

title: Yield not to temptation, for yielding is sin

lines: To thee has oft been giv’n;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Come, O come! (today) Ask not to be excused;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Come, O come! (today) Ask not to be excused;
And points the way to heav’n,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Come, O come! (today) Ask not to be excused;
Lord, for tomorrow and its needs, I do not pray;
Keep me from ev’ry stain of sin, Just for today
Let me no wrong or idle word, Unthinking say;
Set Thou a seal upon my lips, Just for today.
I would both diligently work, And duly pray;
I would be kind in word and deed, Just for today;
O make me strong to do Thy will, Swift to obey,
Willing to sacrifice my self, Just for today.
And if today this life of mine, Should ebb away;
O may Thy promises divine, Still be my stay.
So for tomorrow and its needs, I do not pray;
O keep me, guide me, hold me Lord, Just for Today.

references.title: Wash Me O Lamb Of God

lines: Wash me, O Lamb of God,
Wash me, O Lamb of God,
But Thou canst cleanse each stain
Wash me, O Lamb of God,
So near art Thou to me,
So sweet my rest in Thee –
Wash me, O Lamb of God,
Thou, while I trust in Thee,
Each day to Thee I bring
Saved, while to Thee I cling,

title: Wash Me O Lamb Of God

lines: I must tell Jesus all of my trials, I cannot bear these burdens alone; In my distress He kindly will help me, He ever loves and cares for His own.
I must tell Jesus all of my troubles, He is a kind, compassionate Friend; If I but ask Him He will deliver, Make of my troubles quickly an end.
Oh, how the world to evil allures me! Oh, how my heart is tempted to sin! I must tell Jesus, and He will help me Over the world the vict`ry to win.
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus! I cannot bear my burdens alone; I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus! Jesus can help me, Jesus alone.

references.title: I am redeemed, but not with silver
Nor silver nor gold hath obtained my redemption

lines: Nor silver nor gold hath obtained my redemption,
Nor riches of earth could have saved my poor soul;
The blood of the cross is my only foundation,
The death of my Saviour now maketh me whole.
I am redeemed, but not with silver;
I am bought, but not with gold;
Bought with a price—the blood of Jesus,
Nor silver nor gold hath obtained my redemption,
The guilt on my conscience too heavy had grown;
The blood of the cross is my only foundation,
The death of my Saviour could only atone.
Nor silver nor gold hath obtained my redemption,
The holy commandment forbade me draw near;
The blood of the cross is my only foundation,
The death of my Saviour removeth my fear.
Nor silver nor gold hath obtained my redemption,
The way into heaven could not thus be bought;
The blood of the cross is my only foundation,
The death of my Saviour redemption hath wrought.

title: I am redeemed, but not with silver

lines: I bow and bless the sacred name,
From earth I rise, and seek the joys
And him my only portion make,
I shall, on eagle's wings upborne,
And sing the wonders of his grace
And trees of life for ever grow,
There dwells the Lord our King,
Triumphant over the world and sin,
And glorious with his saints in light
Give thanks to God on high;
Hail Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,
All might and majesty are thine,
For I am the Lord, I change not. Mal. 3:6.
di The landscape droops in autumn sear,
And spring flower bloom to die:
"I will be with thee," saith the Lord.
In faith and hope holy fear,
di How often we distrust the word,
"I will be with thee," saith the Lord.
Midst withering flowers and tempests drear,
"I will be with thee," saith the Lord.
"I change not," is a Father's word.
"And I am with thee," saith the Lord.
The Lord is my shepherd. Ps.23: 1.
From the lion and the wild bear
And from wild and evil beasts
Jesus will guard his lonely sheep
Jesus will care for His own.
He died in order to save me
Jesus, what great love is this?
He leads me in the way of Life,
He makes me rest in green pastures
Where pois'nous weeds do not grow,
There I hear the voice of Jesus
There He makes my heart rejoice.
When I walk the valley of death
And there's fear along my way
I shall not fear any evil,
For my shepherd is so hear
His rod and staff they comfort me
For they make His sheep rejoice.

references.title: Each Day I'll do a Golden Deed

lines: Each day I'll do a golden deed,
By helping those who are in need;
My life on earth is but a span,
And so I'll do the best I can.
To be a child of God each day,
My light must shine along the way;
I'll sing His praise while ages roll,
And strive to help some troubled soul.
The only life that will endure,
Is one that's kind and good and pure;
And so for God I'll take my stand,
Each day I'll lend a helping hand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Life's evening sun... is sinking low,
A few more days... and I must go
To meet the deeds... that I have done,
Where there will be... no setting sun.

title: Each Day I'll do a Golden Deed

lines: Go and tell the story to thy friends to-day,
How the Lord of glory met thee on thy way;
How He cleansed thy spirit from the stain of sin,
Driving out the foe who reigned thy heart within.
Go and tell the story, of His pow'r to save,
Of the sinful "Legion" sunk beneath the wave;
Tell of His compassion, of His love so true,
Of the wondrous things the Lord hath done for you.
Go and tell the story, how He reigns above,
Winning men to glory thro' His dying love;
How He waits to crown them kings forevermore,
In the home awaiting, on the other shore.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Go and tell the story, tell it fer and wide,
How the Lord of glory for the sinner died;
And the soul that hears it, and in faith believes,
Straightway he the cleansing from the Lord receives.
Tenderly guide us, O Shepherd of love,
To the green pastures and waters above,
Guarding us ever by night and by day,
Never from Thee would we stray.
Never! Oh, never! For Thou art the way;
Never from Thee would we stray.
What though the heavens with clouds be o'ercast!-
Fearful the tempest, and bitter the blast!
Still with the light of Thy Word on the way,
Never from Thee would we stray.
Never! Oh, never! For Thou art the way;
Never from Thee would we stray.
Over our weakness Thy strength has been cast;
Keep us in meekness Thy own till the last;
Then, safely folded, with joy we shall say,
Never from Thee would we stray.
Never! Oh, never! For Thou art the way;
Never from Thee would we stray.

references.title: A hymn of glory let us sing

lines: A hymn of glory let us sing;
New songs thro'out the world shall ring:
Christ, by a road before untrod,
Ascendeth to the throne of God.
Upon the Mount of Olives stand;
And with his followers they see
To whom the angels, drawing nigh,
"Why stand and gaze upon the sky?
This is the Saviour," thus they say;
As ye today have seen him go,
Up to the portals of the sky."

title: A hymn of glory let us sing

lines: God has brought us on our way;
Day of all the week the best,
Day of all the week the best,
While we seek supplies of grace,
Take away our sin and shame,
From our worldly cares set free,
May we rest this day in thee;
From our worldly cares set free,
May we rest this day in thee.
Here we come thy name to praise,
May we feel thy presence near,
May thy glory meet our eyes,
While we in thy courts appear.
Here, afford us, Lord, a taste,
Here, afford us, Lord, a taste,
Make the fruit of grace abound,
Thus may all our Sabbaths be,
Till we rise to reign with thee,
Thus may all our Sabbaths be,
Till we rise to reign with thee.
And bids us view His pierced hands,
Points to His wounded feet and side,
What food luxurious loads the board
When at His table sits the Lord!
The wine how rich, the bread how sweet,
When Jesus deigns the guests to meet.
If now, with eyes defiled and dim,
We see the signs, but see not Him,
O may His love the scales displace
And bid us see Him face to face.
Thou glorious Bridegroom of our hearts,
Thy present smile a heaven imparts;
O lift the veil, if veil there be,
Let every saint Thy beauties see.

references.title: To us a Child of hope is born

lines: To us a child of hope is born,
To us a son is giv'n,
Him shall the tribes of earth obey,
Him all the hosts of heaven
His name shall be the Prince of Peace,
His power, increasing, still shall spread,
His reign no end shall know;
Justice shall guard his throne above,
To us a Child of hope is born,
To us a Son is giv'n,

title: To us a Child of hope is born

lines: Let thy light within me shine;
Fill me full of heav'n and love.
Speak thy pard'ning grace to me,
Lead me to the Lamb of God,
Wash me in his precious blood.
Life and peace to me impart;
Let me never from thee stray,
Keep me in the narrow way,
Fill my soul with joy divine,
Keep me, Lord, for ever thine.

references.title: Look, ye saints, the sight is glorious;

lines: Look, ye saints, the sight is glorious;
See the Man of Sorrows now;
Every knee to Him shall bow:
Crown the Saviour, angels crown Him;
In the seat of power enthrone Him,
While the vault of heaven rings;
Crown the Saviour, King of kings.
Saints and angels crowd around Him,
Own His title, praise His Name:
O what joy the sight affords!
King of kings, and Lord of lords.

title: Look, ye saints, the sight is glorious;

references.title: Done is the work that saves

lines: Done is the work that saves,
The love that blesses us below
Is flowing freely to us now.
The veil is rent in twain,
Why stand we then without, in fear?
The blood of Christ invites us near.
Is clear, and free, and bright
With love, and peace, and day.
Into the holiest now we come,
Our present and our endless home.
Has made and keeps us clean;
With boldness let us now draw near;
That blood has banished every fear.
Then to the Lamb once slain
Who loved us, cleansed us by His blood,
And made us kings and priests to God.

title: Done is the work that saves

lines: How sweet the name of Jesus sounds In a believer`s ear! It soothes his sorrows, heals his wounds, And drives away his fear.
It makes the wounded spirit whole, And calms the troubled breast; `Tis manna to the hungry soul, And to the weary, rest.
Dear name, the rock on which I build, My shield and hiding place, My neverfailing treasury, filled With boundless stores of grace.
Jesus! my Shepherd, Guardian, Friend, My Prophet, Priest, and King! My Lord, my life, my way, my end! Accept the praise I bring.
Weak is the effort of my heart, And cold my warmest thought; But when I see Thee as Thou art, I`ll praise Thee as I ought.

references.title: The Head that once was crowned with thorns

lines: The Head that once was crowned with thorns
The highest place that heav'n affords
Is his, is his by right,
The King of kings and Lord of lords,
The Joy of all who dwell above,
To whom he manifests his love,
And grants his Name to know.
To them the cross, with all its shame,
With all its grace, is giv'n;
Their joy the joy of heav'n.
They suffer with their Lord below,
Their profit and their joy to know
The cross he bore is life and health,
Though shame and death to him;
His people's hope, his people's wealth,

title: The Head that once was crowned with thorns

references.title: Thy love has spared our lives today

lines: He who keepeth thee will not slumber Ps. 121: 3
Thy love has spared our lives today
Though we lay-down, spent and worn,
Guard us in the stillness of night,
Us no pow'rs of darkness harm;
It is sweet to trust in Thee.
Pilgrims in this world and strangers
Dwelling in the midst of foes;
Keep us and dear ones from danger,
On thy wings in comfort sleep;
And when life's distress is over,
May our souls repose in Thee.

title: Thy love has spared our lives today

lines: We have a High priest, that is passed into the heavens. Heb. 4:14
Jesus ascends up to the skies
Our great High priest ascends on High.
That of the Lamb of God;
Pure than the blood of bull

references.title: O Christ, our hope, our heart's desire

lines: O Christ, our hope, our heart's desire,
Creator of the world art thou,
How vast the mercy and the love
Which laid our sins on thee,
And led thee to a cruel death,
But now the bands of death are burst,
And thou art on thy Father's throne,
O Christ, be thou our lasting joy,
Our only glory may it be

title: O Christ, our hope, our heart's desire

lines: Savior! Thy dying love Thou gavest me,
Nor should I aught withhold, My Lord from Thee;
In love my soul would bow, my heart fulfill its vow,
Give me a faithful heart, likeness to Thee,
That each departing day henceforth may see
Some work of love begun, some deed of kindness done,
All that I am and have, Thy gifts so free
In joy, in grief, through life, O Lord, for Thee!
And when Thy face I see, My ransomed soul shall be

references.title: Jesus Christ, Thou King of Glory

lines: Jesus Christ, Thou King of Glory,
Singing of Thy grace the story,
Thou the bands of death didst sever,
God is for us now and ever;
We joy in Thee. We are Thine,
Thou the ransom price hast given,
Thou art Lord of earth and heaven;
Through Thy blood we stand forgiven,
Sweet and full our song shall be;
Thou hast read our spirits' yearning,

title: Jesus Christ, Thou King of Glory

references.title: Amazing Grace! How Sweet the Sound

lines: Amazing grace! how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found,
Was blind, but now I see.
'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
How precious did that grace appear
Thro' many dangers, toils, and snares,
'Tis grace hath bro't me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.
The Lord has promised good to me,
He will my shield and portion be,
When we've been there ten thousand years,
We've no less days to sing God's praise

title: Amazing Grace! How Sweet the Sound

references.title: Lord, with glowing heart I'd praise thee

lines: Lord, with glowing heart I'd praise thee
For the bliss thy love bestows,
For the pard'ning grace that saves me,
And the peace that from it flows;
Help, O God, my weak endeavor;
This dull soul to rapture raise;
Thou must light the flame, or never
Can my love be warmed to praise.
Praise, my soul, the God that sought thee,
Found thee lost, and kindly brought thee
From the paths of death away;
Him who saw thy guilt-born fear,
And, the light of hope revealing,
Praise thy Saviour God that drew thee
To that cross, new life to give,
Held a blood-sealed pardon to thee,
Bade thee look to him and live;
Praise the grace whose threats alarmed thee,
Roused thee from thy fatal ease,
Praise the grace whose promise warmed thee,
Praise the grace that whispered peace.
Deign thy suppliant's prayer to bless:
Let thy love, my soul's chief treasure,
Love's pure flame within me raise,
And, since words can never measure,
Let my life show forth thy praise.

title: Lord, with glowing heart I'd praise thee

references.title: I Am Waiting for the Dawning

lines: I am waiting for the dawning
Of the bright and blessed day,
When the darksome night of sorrow
Far beyond this vale of tears,
I shall swell the song of worship
I am looking at the brightness,
Of the clear and joyous beaming
Through the dark grey mist of morning
Do I see its glorious light;
Of this sad and weary night.
I am waiting for the coming
Of the Lord who died for me;
O His words have thrilled my spirit:
I can almost hear His footfall
On the threshold of the door,
And my heart, my heart is longing

title: I Am Waiting for the Dawning

references.title: In the hour we have to part

lines: The Lord watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another. Gen 31:49.
In the hour we have to part
To the watchful eye and heart
Of our dearest and close Friend.
Jesus Christ, hear Thou our pray'rs,
Thou the guardian of Thy sheep,
May Thy mercy and Thy care,
All our hearts in safety keep.
Grant that we have strength through Thee
Spare our lives we pray, dear Lord,

title: In the hour we have to part

lines: Who bowed His head and died;
Who hath redeemed us by His blood;
Who bears us on His breast,
O let this hope dispel each fear,
Our great High Priest will soon appear.
Of love divine, His flock He'll bring.
He comes! the Heir of all,
But O His love, what tongue can tell?
Naught else can satisfy her heart
But to be with Thee where Thou art.

references.title: Lord, from this time we cry to thee;

lines: My Father, thou art the guide of my youth jer. 3:4
Lord, from this time we cry to thee;
Thou of our youth the Guide shalt be;
Draw near and take us by the hand,
And lead into the goodly land;
With fire by night and cloud by day
Be with us on our pilgrim way.
Forth to the wilderness we go,
The Tempter's wiles ordain'd to know;
Though weak our arm, and fierce the fight,
Still may we conquer through Thy might,
Our souls are fed with angels' food.
In sorrow's cloud, in trouble's sea,
Baptized afresh, O Lord, to Thee,
While every joy that round us springs
Each journey done, each danger past,
Receive us to Thy rest at last.
Uphold our footsteps in Thy way,
Not suffer us in heart to stray;
With patience bear, with counsel guide,
Form follies wean, from perils hide;
In sufr'ring soothe, in want defend,
Confirm and stablish to the end.

title: Lord, from this time we cry to thee;

lines: And in the presence of our Lord

references.title: This day at thy creating word

lines: This day at thy creating word
First o'er the earth the light was poured:
O Lord, this day upon us shine
And fill our souls with light divine.
This day the Lord for sinners slain
O Jesus, may we raised be
From death of sin to life in thee!
This day the Holy Spirit came
With fiery tongues of cloven flame:
O Spirit, fill our hearts this day
With grace to hear and grace to pray.
O day of light and life and grace,
From earthly toil sweet resting place,
Thy hallowed hours, blest gift of love,
Give we again to God above.
All praise to God the Father be,
All praise, eternal Son, to thee,
Whom, with the Spirit, we adore

title: This day at thy creating word

references.title: Let us with a gladsome mind

lines: For His mercy endureth for ever. Ps. 136:1
Let us with a gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, for He is kind;
Filled the new-made world with light;
All things living he doth feed,
His full hand supplies their need:
He His chosen race did bless
Let us then with gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, for He is kind:

title: Let us with a gladsome mind

lines: Thy zeal for God in me,
So shall the fervour of my zeal
Be the pure flame of love.
And vow to hold the world but loss
The league with God be solemnized,
The warfare may be sharp and long
When faith casts every trophy down

references.title: Ours are peace and joy divine

lines: Ours are peace and joy divine,
When, like branches in the vine,
We may bear all holy fruit
Love of Christ, love of Christ,
Other's woes pierce like a dart
Sinners warn to flee from hell,
Love of Christ, love of Christ,
Heaven's ranks we'll seek to swell
We will love with tender care,
And our love to all shall flow
Love of Christ, love of Christ,
We now love all Christ-like ones
Now we live and walk by faith
Depths and heights of love explore,
Till we gain the heavenly shore
Love of Christ, love of Christ,
When He comes we then shall know

title: Ours are peace and joy divine

lines: I have found thee with everlasting love. Jer. 32:13
Led by grace that love to know;
Thou hast taught me it is so!
Oh this full and perfect peace!
Oh this full transport all divine!
In a love which cannot cease,
I am His, and He is mine;
In a love which cannot cease
I am His, and He is mine.
Since I know, as now I know,
I am His, and He is mine.
Things that once were wild alarms
Oh to lie for ever here,
Doubt and care and self resign,
While He whispers in my ear-
I am His, and He is mine!
Who the Lord and me shall part!
Ah with what a rest of bliss
Christ can fill the loving heart!
Heav'n and earth may fade and flee,
But, while God and I shall be,
I am His and He is mine.
I'll praise my Maker while I've breath;
And when my voice is lost in death,
Praise shall employ my nobler pow'rs.
My days of praise shall ne'er be past,
While life, and tho't, and being last,
Happy the man whose hopes rely
On Israel's God! He made the sky,
And earth, and seas, with all their train:
He saves th' oppressed, He feeds the poor,
And none shall find His promise vain.
The Lord pours eyesight on the blind;
The Lord supports the fainting mind;
He sends the lab'ring conscience peace;
He helps the stranger in distress,
And grants the pris'ner sweet release.
I'll praise Him while He lends me breath;
And when my voice is lost in death,
Praise shall employ my nobler pow'rs.
My days of praise shall ne'er be past,
While life, and tho't, and being last,

references.title: Lo, He Comes with Clouds Descending

lines: Lo, he comes with clouds descending,
swell the triumph of his train.
God appears on earth to reign.
Every eye shall now behold him,
those who set at naught and sold him,
pierced and nailed him to the tree,
deeply wailing, deeply wailing, deeply wailing,
The dear tokens of his passion
with what rapture, with what rapture, with what rapture,
gaze we on those glorious scars!
Yea, Amen! Let all adore thee,
Savior, take the power and glory,
claim the kingdom for thine own.

title: Lo, He Comes with Clouds Descending

references.title: The Last Mile Of The Way

lines: If I walk in the pathway of duty,
If I work till the close of the day;
I shall see the great King in His beauty
When I've gone the last mile of the way.
If for Christ I proclaim the glad story,
If I seek for His sheep gone astray;
I am sure He will show me His glory
When I've gone the last mile of the way.
Here the dearest of ties we must sever,
Tears of sorrow are seen everyday;
But no sickness, no sighing forever
When I've gone the last mile of the way.
And if here I have earnestly striven
And have tried all His will to obey;
'Twill enhance all the rapture of heaven
When I've gone the last mile of the way.

title: The Last Mile Of The Way

lines: O what a wonderful, wonderful day –
After I'd wandered in darkness away,
O what a tender, compassionate Friend –
He met the need of my heart;
Shadows dispelling, with joy I am telling,
He made all the darkness depart!
Born of the Spirit with life from above
O what a standing is mine!
And the transaction so quickly was made
When as a sinner I came,
Took of the offer of grace He did proffer –
He saved me, O praise His dear name.
Now I've a hope that will surely endure
I have a future in heaven for sure,
And it's because of that wonderful day
When at the cross I believed;
From His precious hand I received.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Heaven came down and glory filled my soul,
When at the cross the Saviour made me whole;
And my night was turned to day –
Heaven came down and glory filled my soul.

references.title: O Let Me Walk With Thee

lines: O let me walk with Thee, my God, As Enoch walked in days of old; Place Thou my trembling hand in Thine, And sweet communion with me hold; E`en though the path I may not see, Yet, Jesus, let me walk with Thee.
I cannot, dare not, walk alone; The tempest rages in the sky, A thousand snares beset my feet, A thousand foes are lurking nigh. Still Thou the raging of the sea, O Master! let me walk with Thee.

If I may rest my hand in Thine, I`ll count the joys of earth but loss, And firmly, bravely journey on; I`ll bear the banner of the cross Till Zion`s glorious gates I see; Yet, Savior, let me walk with Thee.

title: O Let Me Walk With Thee

references.title: I Think When I Read the Sweet Story

lines: I think when I read the sweet story of old,
When Jesus was here among men,
How He called little children as lambs to His fold,
I should like to have been with them then;
I wish that His hands had been placed on my head,
That His arms had been thrown around me,
And that I might have seen His kind look when He said:
Let the little ones come unto me!
Yet still to His footstool in prayer I may go,
And ask for a share of His love:
And if I now earnestly seek Him below,
I shall see Him and hear Him above.
In that beautiful place He has gone to prepare
For all who are washed and forgiven;
And many dear children are gathering there
For of such is the kingdom of heaven.
But for thousands and thousands who wonder and fall,
Never heard of that heavenly home;
I should like them to know there is room for them all,
And that Jesus has bid them to come.
I long for the joy of that glorious time,
The sweetest and brightest and best,
When the dear little children of every clime
Shall crowd to arms and be blessed.

title: I Think When I Read the Sweet Story

references.title: King Of Glory, King of Peace

lines: King of glory, King of peace,
And that love may never cease,
Thou didst note my working breast,
And the cream of all my heart
Though my sins against me cried,
Seven whole days, not one in seven,
In my heart, though not in heav’n,
Small it is, in this poor sort

title: King Of Glory, King of Peace

lines: O, for a faith that will not shrink, Though pressed by many a foe, That will not tremble on the brink of poverty, Of poverty or woe; Of poverty or woe;
That will not murmur or complain Beneath the chastening rod, But in the hour of grief or pain, of grief or pain Can lean upon its God; Can lean upon its God.
A faith that shines more bright and clear When tempests rage without; That when in danger knows no fear, knows of no fear, In darkness feels no doubt; In darkness feels no doubt.
That bears unmoved the world`s dread frown, Nor heeds its scornful smile; That sin`s wild ocean cannot drown, no, cannot drown, Nor its soft arts beguile; Nor its soft arts beguile.
Lord, give me such a faith as this, And then, whate`er may come I`ll taste, e`en here the hallowed bliss, the hallowed bliss Of an eternal home; Of an eternal home.

references.title: O'er the gloomy hills of darkness

lines: O'er the gloomy hills of darkness,
Bring the bright, the glorious day;
Kingdoms wide that sit in darkness,
Grant them, Lord, the glorious light;
And from eastern coast to western
May the morning chase the night,

title: O'er the gloomy hills of darkness

references.title: O Sunday School, on the Lord's day

lines: O Sunday School, on the Lord's day
O how I love Thee well,
I am happy, it makes me glad
O Sunday School, on the Lord's day
Both young and old will sing Thy song
O Sunday School, on the Lord's day
O Sunday School, on the Lord's day
O Sunday School, on the Lord's day
Though the sun be so bright
Or if the clouds be black with rain,
O Sunday School, on the Lord's day
Will Thou pass over me today

title: O Sunday School, on the Lord's day

lines: Just as God who reigns on high
Spake to men in days gone by;
So the Lord is calling men today;
And, my brother, this is true,
There is but one thing to do -
If you're in the Saviour's hands,
You must do as He commands,
For there is no other gospel way;
When the Saviour speaks to you -
If for mansions fair you sigh,
In that land beyond the sky,
After time with you has pass'd away;
Though the way you may not see,
Faith and duty both will cry -

sections.label: Refrain
lines: When His message comes to you,
There is but one thing to do:
You who feel the tempter's pow'r;
Watch with Him one bitter hour;
Turn not from His griefs away;
Learn of Jesus Christ to pray.
See Him at the judgment hall;
View the Lord of life arraigned:
O the wormwood and the gall!
O the pangs His soul sustained!
Shun not suff'ring, shame, or loss;
Learn of Him to bear the cross.
Learn of Jesus Christ to die.
Where they laid His breathless clay;
Christ is ris'n! He meets our eyes;
Savior, teach us so to rise.

references.title: All thanks O Lord to Thee

lines: And this day shall be unto you far a memorial and ye shall
keep it a feast to the Lord. Exod. 12:14
All thanks O Lord to Thee
All thanks to Thee O Lord
We shall work for the growth
di Let Thy blessing O Lord
To serve Thee to the end

title: All thanks O Lord to Thee

lines: There shall be showers of blessing:
This is the promise of love;
There shall be showers of blessing,
Over the hills and the valleys,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: But for the showers we plead.
The voice of a great multitude saying, Hallelujah Rev. 19:6
To our God upon the throne,
On an on, from dawn to sunset,
Of the hoary climes of Ind,
From the ransom'd sons of Afric,
From the coasts of ice to regions
From the watchers for His advent
Who will soon to Zion come;
Hark, that glorious tide of song,
Floods the valley with its music,
Of the living God it fills.
Hark, it mingles with the raptures
Of the armies of the sky,
Clothed in robes of spotless beauty,
Palms of triumph in their hand,
As before His face they stand.
Him who wash'd us with His blood
Kings and priests henceforth for ever
To our Father and our God,
O come all ye faithful, joyful and triumphant,
O come ye, O come ye, to Bethlehem.
Come and behold him, born the King of angels;
True God of true God, Light from Light Eternal,
lo, he shuns not the Virgin's womb;
Son of the Father, begotten not created;
Sing, choirs of angels, sing in exultation;
O sing, all ye citizens of heaven above!
Glory to God, all glory in the highest;
See how the shepherds, summoned to his cradle,
leaving their flocks, draw nigh to gaze;
we too will thither bend our joyful footsteps;
Child, for us sinners poor and in the manger,
we would embrace thee with love and awe.
Who would not love thee, loving us so dearly?
Yea, Lord, we greet thee, born this happy morning,
Jesus, to thee be all glory given.
Word of the Father, now in flesh appearing:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O come let us adore him, O come let us adore him,
O come let us adore him, Christ the Lord.

references.title: The happy day at last has dawned

lines: The happy day at last has dawned
Here on the earth in human form
Watching over their flocks by night
First e'er, the glad tidings were told
Glad tidings of the Saviour's birth.
Who came in shining white app'rel
Brought to them the blessed message,
The true, glad tidings of great joy
A mighty dread had seized their mind
Because of this strange sight they saw;
That came from the angelic lips.
Christ the Saviour is born today
Yet Christ the Lord on earth is He
In David's city is He born
"All glory be to God on high"
Will be the chorus by all clime
For His tender and endless love
That to a world in need brought peace

title: The happy day at last has dawned

references.title: I will sing you a song of that beautiful land

lines: I will sing you a song of that beautiful land,
The far away home of the soul,
Where no storms ever beat on the glittering strand,
While the years of eternity roll.
O that home of the soul! In my visions and dreams,
Its bright jasper walls I can see;
Till I fancy but thinly the vail intervenes
Between the fair city and me.
That unchangeable home is for you and for me,
The King of all kingdoms for ever is he,
And he holdeth our crowns in his hands.
O how sweet it will be in that beautiful land,
So free from all sorrow and pain,
With songs on our lips and with harps in our hands,

references.title: A mind at perfect peace with God

lines: A mind at perfect peace with God,
Oh! what a word is this!
By nature and by practice far,
Yet now by grace brought nigh to Him.
So near, so very near to God,
For in the person of His Son
I am as near as He.
So dear, so very dear to God,
The love wherewith He loves the Son.
Such is His love to me.
Why should I ever careful be
Since such a God is mine?
He watches o'er me night and day,

title: A mind at perfect peace with God

references.title: ’Tis Almost Time for the Lord to Come

lines: ’Tis almost time for the Lord to come,
The stars of heaven are growing dim,
It must be the breaking of the day.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!
The signs foretold in the sun and moon,
In earth and sea and sky,
The coming of the Master draweth nigh.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!
It must be time for the waiting church
With girded loins and burning lamps,
To look for the breaking of the day.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!
Go quickly out in the streets and lanes
And call the maimed, the halt, and blind,
To be ready for the breaking of the day.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!
O it must be the breaking of the day!

title: ’Tis Almost Time for the Lord to Come

references.title: O safe to the rock that is higher than I

lines: O safe to the rock that is higher than I
My soul in its conflicts and sorrows would fly;
So sinful, so weary, Thine, Thine would I be;
Thou blest Rock of Ages I'm hiding in Thee.
In the calm of the noontide, in sorrow's lone hour,
In times when temptation casts o'er me its power;
In the tempest of life, on its wide, heaving sea,
Thou blest Rock of Ages I'm hiding in Thee.
How oft in the conflict, when pressed by the foe,
I have fled to my refuge, and breathed out my woe;
How often, when trials like sea-billows roll,
Have I hidden in Thee O Thou rock of my soul.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hiding in Thee, hiding in Thee,
Thou blest Rock of Ages I'm hiding in Thee.

title: O safe to the rock that is higher than I

lines: Those who saw that the Saviour died
Mercy and truth in warm embrace,
Our Saviour broke th sing of death
The saints who died also arose
And they shall no more die.

references.title: The veil is rent: Lo! Jesus stands

lines: The veil is rent: Lo! Jesus stands
And clouds of incense from His hands
His precious blood is sprinkled there,
And His own wounds in heaven declare
His work on earth is done.
"'Tis finished!" on the Cross He said,
'Tis finished! Now He lives to plead
'Tis finished! Here our souls can rest,
By Him, our Sacrifice and Priest,
Before Thy throne Thy children fall,
Boldly our heart and voice we raise,
His Name, His blood, our plea;
Assured our prayers and songs of praise

title: The veil is rent: Lo! Jesus stands

references.title: Lo, What a Glorious Sight Appears

lines: Lo, what a glorious sight appears To our believing eyes! The earth and seas are passed away And the old rolling skies. And the old rolling skies, And the old rolling skies; The earth and seas are passed away, And the old rolling skies.

Attending angels shout for joy And the bright armies sing- Mortals! Behold the sacred seat Of your descending King. Of your descending King, Of your descending King; Mortals! Behold the sacred seat Of your descending King.

His own soft hand shall wipe the tears From every weeping eye; And pains, and groans, and griefs, and fears, And death itself shall die! And death itself shall die, And death itself shall die; And pains, and groans, and griefs, and fears, And death itself shall die.

How long, dear Savior! Oh, how long Shall this bright hour delay? Fly swifter round, ye wheels of time! And bring the welcome day. And bring the welcome day, And bring the welcome day; Fly swifter round, ye wheels of time! And bring the welcome day.

O that will be joyful, joyful, joyful! O that will be joyful When we meet to part no more! When we meet to part no more On Canaan`s happy shore; `Tis there we`ll meet at Jesus` feet, When we meet to part no more!

title: Lo, What a Glorious Sight Appears

references.title: To thee, O Lord, I fly

lines: To thee, O Lord, I fly
Thou art my Lord and King Most High;
A heritage for me Jehovah will remain;
My portion rich and full is he,
The lot to me that fell
The heritage in which I dwell
My heart instructs me in his love
The Lord whom I have proved;
At my right hand he guards from ill,
And I shall not be moved.
To thy right hand wilt guide,
Where streams of pleasure ever flow,

title: To thee, O Lord, I fly

lines: Ye nations, bow with sacred joy;
Know that the Lord is God alone;
He can create; and He destroy
His sov'reign pow'r, without our aid,
Made us of clay, and form'd us men,
And when like wand'ring sheep we strayed,
He brought us to His fold again.
We'll crowd Thy gates with thankful songs,
High as the heavens our voices raise, tongue
And earth, with her ten thousand tongues,

Lift up your heads, pilgrims aweary

lines: Lift up your heads, pilgrims aweary,
See day's approach now crimson the sky;
Night shadows flee, and your Beloved,
Awaited with longing, at last draweth nigh.
He is coming again, he is coming again,
The very same Jesus, rejected of men;
He is coming again, he is coming again,
With power and great glory, he is coming again.
Dark was the night, sin warred against us;
Heavy the load of sorrow we bore;
But now we see signs of his coming;
Our hearts glow within us, joy's cup runneth o'er!
O blessed hope! O blissful promise!
Filling our hearts with rapture divine;
O day of days! hail thine appearing!
Thy transcendent glory for ever shall shine.
Even so come, precious Lord Jesus;
Caught up in clouds, soon we shall meet thee;
O blessed assurance, for ever with thee!

title: He is coming again, he is coming again

references.title: Not what these hands have done

lines: Not what my hands have done
Not what my toiling flesh has borne
Not what I feel or do
Can give me peace with God;
Not all my prayers and sighs and tears
Can ease this weight of sin;
Thy blood alone, O Lamb of God,
Thy love to me, O God,
Not mine, O Lord to thee,
Can rid me of this dark unrest
Thy pow'r alone, O Son of God,
No strength, save that which is divine,
I bless the Christ of God;
And with unfalt'ring lip and heart
Each thought of unbelief and fear,
I praise the God of grace;
I trust his truth and might;
He calls me his, I call him mine,
My God, my joy, my light.
I love because he loveth me,

title: Not what these hands have done

lines: After the Lord hath spoken unto them, He was received up into heaven.
Hail the day that sees Him rise,
Take the king of Glory in!
Still He loves the earth He leaves;
Still He calls mankind His own.
See! He lifts His hands above;
See! He shows the prints of love;
Still for us His death He pleads;
Grant, though parted from our sight,
Grant our hearts may thither rise,
There we shall with Thee remain,
Find our heav'n of in Thee.

references.title: Lord Jesus, let Thy favour rest

Their constant springs be found in Thee,
As fellow-heirs of life in Thee,
Their mutual faith and love still be
And when the day of light shall shine,
Thou then with joy wilt own as Thine,

title: Lord Jesus, let Thy favour rest

references.title: Sun of my soul, Thou Saviour dear,

lines: Sun of my soul, Thou Saviour dear,
It is not night if Thou be near;
O may no earth-born cloud arise
To hide Thee from Thy servant's eyes!
When the soft dews of kindly sleep
Be my last though, How sweet to rest
For ever no my Savior's breast!
Abide with me from morn till eve,
For without Thee I cannot live;
Abide with me when night is night,
For without Thee I dare not die
If some poor wand'ring child of Thine
Have spurned to day the voice divine,
Now, Lord, the gracious work being;
Let him no more lie down in sin.
watch by the e sick; enrich the poor
With blessings from Thy boundless store;
di Be every mourner's sleep to-night
Like infant's slumbers, pure and light
Come near and bless us when we wake,
Ere through the world our way we take,
Till in the ocean of Thy love
We lose ourselves in heav'n above.

title: Sun of my soul, Thou Saviour dear,

lines: Sweet hour of prayer, sweet hour of prayer,
That calls me from a world of care,
And bids me, at my Father’s throne,
Make all my wants and wishes known!
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief,
And oft escaped the tempters snare,
By thy return, sweet hour of prayer!
Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
Thy wings shall my petition bear
To Him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless.
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe His word, and trust His grace,
I’ll cast on Him my every care,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer.
Sweet hour of prayer! sweet hour of prayer!
Till from Mount Pisgah’s lofty height
I view my home and take my flight.
In my immortal flesh I’ll rise
And shout while passing through the air,

references.title: Praise the Lord, who died to save us

lines: Praise the Lord, who died to save us,
Praise Him that He lives to bless us,
We would all Thy love proclaim.
Grace it was, yea, grace abounding,
Brought Thee down to save the lost;
Praise Him, praise Him all His host:
Ye are they who owe Him most.
We, of all His hand created,
Destined now to share His throne,
Sing of what our Lord hath done.
Praise His Name, who died to save us;
And in Him the Father gave us
All that boundless love could give:

references.title: Jesus, thou Joy of loving hearts (tune 1)
Jesus, thou Joy of loving hearts (tune 2)

lines: Jesus, thou Joy of loving hearts,
Thou Fount of life, thou Light of men,
From the best bliss that earth imparts
We turn unfilled to thee again.
Thy truth unchanged hath ever stood;
Thou savest those that on thee call;
To them that seek thee thou art good,
To them that find thee all in all.
We taste thee, O thou living Bread,
And long to feast upon thee still;
We drink of thee, the Fountainhead,
And thirst our souls from thee to fill.
Our restless spirits yearn for thee,
Where'er our changeful lot is cast;
Glad when thy gracious smile we see,
Blest when our faith can hold thee fast.
O Jesus, ever with us stay,
Make all our moments calm and bright;
Chase the dark night of sin away,
Shed o'er the world thy holy light.

The trump that angels quake to hear,
Thrill'd from the deep, dark cloud:
So, when the spirit of our God
Came down His flock to find,
A voice from heav'n was heard abroad,
It fills the church of God; it fills
Only in stubborn hearts and wills
No place for it is found
Come, Lord; come, Wisdom, Love, and Pow'r;

Save, Lord, by love or fear.

references.title: Trust and obey, for there's no other way
When we walk with the Lord

lines: When we walk with the Lord in the light of his Word
What a glory he sheds on our way!
While we do his good will, he abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.
Trust and obey, for there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.
Not a shadow can rise, not a cloud in the skies,
But his smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt or a fear, not a sigh nor a tear,
Can abide while we trust and obey.
Not a burden we bear, not a sorrow we share,
But our toil he doth richly repay;
Not a grief nor a loss, not a frown or a cross,
But is blest if we trust and obey.
But we never can prove the delights of his love
Until all on the altar we lay;
For the favor he shows, and the joy he bestows,
Are for them who will trust and obey.
Then in fellowship sweet we will sit at his feet,
Or we will walk by his side in the way;
What he says we will do, where he sends we will go,
Never fear, only trust and obey.

title: Trust and obey, for there's no other way

lines: From all that dwell below the skies,

in songs of praise divinely sing;
and shout for joy the Savior's name.
In every land begin the song;
to every land the strains belong;
in cheerful sounds all voices raise,
and fill the world with loudest praise.

title: From All That Dwell Below the Skies

references.title: Dear Lord and Father of Mankind

lines: Dear Lord and Father of mankind, forgive our foolish ways; reclothe us in our rightful mind, in purer lives thy service find, in deeper reverence, praise.
In simple trust like theirs who heard, beside the Syrian sea, the gracious calling of the Lord, let us, like them, without a word, rise up and follow thee.
O sabbath rest by Galilee, O calm of hills above, where Jesus knelt to share with thee the silence of eternity, interpreted by love!
Drop thy still dews of quietness, till all our strivings cease; take from our souls the strain and stress, and let our ordered lives confess the beauty of thy peace.
Breathe through the heats of our desire thy coolness and thy balm; let sense be dumb, let flesh retire; speak through the earthquake, wind, and fire, O still, small voice of calm.

references.title: My rest is in heaven, my rest is not here

lines: My rest is in heaven, my rest is not here,
Then why should I murmur when trials are near?
Be hushed my sad spirit, the worst that can come
But shortens the journey and hastens me home.
It is not for me to be seeking my bliss,
And building my hopes in a region like this;
I look for a city which hands have not piled;
I pant for a country by sin undefiled.
The winds of affliction around me may blow,
And dash my lone barque as I'm sailing below;
I smile at the storm as I lean on His breast,
And soon I shall land in the haven of rest.
Let trial and danger my progress oppose,
They only make heaven more sweet at the close;
Come joy or come sorrow, whate'er may befall,
A home with my God will make up for it all.
With Christ in my heart, and His Word in my hand,
I travel in haste through an enemy's land;
The road may be rough, but it cannot be long,
So I journey on singing the conqueror's song.

title: My rest is in heaven, my rest is not here

Sweet Sabbath rest, your sacred hours Are as a golden chain That reaches back to Eden`s gate And points us home again.
And when this earth shall be renewed, And sin and death destroyed, Shall all redeemed each Sabbath day Still meet to praise their God.

title: Dear Lord, We Come at Set of Sun

lines: Rise up, O men of God!
Give heart and mind and soul and strength

Rise up, O men of God!
Bring in the day of brotherhood

The church for you doth wait,
her strength unequal to her task;
rise up, and make her great!
Lift high the cross of Christ!
Tread where his feet have trod.

rise up, O men of God!
