Apake kuom remo maler,En Jawar miwuoro ngang`!Moriwo chunya gi Nyasaye,En Jawar miwuoro ngang`.
Ogolo richo e chunya,En Jawar miwuoro ngang`!Koro obedo Ruoth maduong`,En Jawar miwuro ngang`.
Owuotho koda yo duto,En Jawar miwuoro ngang`!Omiya teko mar ritruok,En Jawar miwuoro ngang`!

title: Kristo Obedo Misango Mar Golo Richo

lines: Pakeuru, un nyithindo duto,En hera, En hera;Pakeuru, un nyithindo duto,En hera, En hera.
Hereuru un nyithindo duto,En hera, En hera;Hereuru, un nyithindo duto,En hera, En hera.
Luweuru, un nyithindo duto,En hera, En hera;Luweuru, un nyithindo duto,En hera, En hera.
Un nyithindo, ruak Yesu e chunyu,En hera, En hera;Un nyithindo, ruak Yesu e chunyu,En hera, En hera.
Aseweyo tich maricho,Ni mondo alu Yesu;En ma yandi ji nochaye,Osedoko ngimana.Ok ageno teko moro,Ok ageno pith mar piny;Pith adieri ni e chunya;Ruoth mar polo ni Ruodha.
Kata ji duto oriemba,Ji duto noweyo En;Chuny marach owuondo pile,En kende e mageno.Ka da herane bet koda,Kuyo ok donyal maka.Ok danwang` mor e piny kae,Ka da onge herano.
Yesu kende e moroma,Muche mond` orit chunya;Eka tichne anamaki,Enopuonja kindane.Pinywani otimo mudho;Chieng` mudho nolal chutho,Konya! mond` achungi chieng`noE pinyruodhi mosiko.
Nitie kamaber mar yweyomachiegni gi Nyasaye;Kama richo ok nyal donje,machiegni gi Nyasaye.
Ruoth Yesu ma Jawarwa,No or koa polo,Iwinjwa wan mwariti,machiegni gi Nyasaye.
Nitie kanyo maber mar hoch,machiegni gi Nyasaye;Kama warom` e gi Jawar,machiegni gi Nyasaye.
Kanyo ji duto ni thuolo,machiegni gi Nyasaye,En kama mor gi kwe nitie,machiegni gi Nyasaye.
Chon nyithindo nower wer mamit,Ka ne gipako Yesu Ruodh polo;"Hosana, Hosana,Hosana e polo malo."
Weruru, weruru,Nyithindo mondo giwer wendgi mamit;Weruru, weruruYesu ohero winjo wer.
Yesu pod ohero winjo wer,Koro kwapake, Yesu Ruodh Polo;"Hosana, Hosana,Hosana e polo malo."
Wabiro wero wer mamit chutho,gi jo mowar, eka wanamor ngang`;"Hosana, Hosana,Hosana e polo malo."
Diyie dak kod Yesu,mond` ibed maler pile?Diyie wuoth kodee yo madiny koso?Diyie mond` okaw ting`niduto koting`oni?Yiene ni mond` otelni.
Tekone nyalolosi makare,Rembe nyaloluoko chunyi maler;Hera mare nyalomi chunyi mor;Diber kiyie mondoRuoth otelni.
Diyie mond` ogonyikendo iwinj wach mare?Donge ing`eyo kuwema chiwruok kelo?Ok diher mond` owari,kik ipodhi e keth?Yiene ni mond` otelni.
Diher yud kar bete pinyruodhe malo koso?Diher ng`eyo tekonemar loyo tem?Idwaro tiyo ni Ruothgi tekoni duto?Yiene ni mond` otelni.
Ywaya iri, iri, iri, Ruoth maber,E msalaba kar thoni;Ywaya iri, iri, iri, Ruoth maber,Nyaka abed mari chutho.
"Un jo mojony, biuru,Namiu yueyo, An;"Winjuru dwond Ruoth Yesu,owuoyonwa koro;Onyisowa ng`wonone,kaka nowenwa keth;Gi mor mar chuny mosiko,gi hera mochwere.
"Biuru, un muruenyo,to anamiu ler;"Dwond Yesu `hoyo chunywaka mudho imowaChunywa nepong` gi kuyo,Wang`yo noselalnwa;To osemiyowa mor,Wanadende koro.
Un jo mool, motho,to Yesu oluongou;Odwaro miu ngima,nokonyu e lwenju;Jasigu tek ahinya,Lweny kedore mager;To waseyudo tekomar loyo jasikwa.
"Ng`a manade mabirook anajwang`e ngang`;"Ok wanyal go kiawakwawinjo dwond Yesu;Oluongowa - moketho,wan jo mak winjre ngang`,Gi herane gi ng`wono;Wabironi, Ruodhwa.

Aparo koro kuom pinyno maber,Piny maber, maber ngang`;En kar yuweyo maber bang` chandruok duto.Piny maber kendo mar kuwe,En piny ma nosingi chon ni jogo maler.Giniyue kuom chandruok duto,Kama cham kod olembe nomi chunywa mor.
E pinyno maber ngang`,En piny maber, en piny maber;En piny maber, maber chutho,En piny maber, en piny maber,En piny maber, en piny maber ngang`.

Anawer wende mag hera kanyo,Piny maber, maber ngang`;Anapak Jawarna gi wende mamitPiny maber kendo mar kuwe,Wanawinj thumbe mayuak mamit e polo;Duonde duoko mamit kendoKa jomalaika maler nower gi mor,E pinyno maber ngang`.
Koro aneno kar dak mepolo,Piny maber, maber ngang`;Piny maber kendo mar kuwe,Osiepe ma jowuodha koro chiegni wuok,Asewinjo duondgi koro;Nikech yie nigi teko mar fwenyo weche;Mag pinyno maber ngang`.
Bedi koda, piny koro yusona;Polo to chido, Yesu bed koda;Ka onge moro madhi konyoa,Jakony jochan Iwuon, bedi koda.
Chieng` ndalona to koro rumona;Gik managombo tinde kadhona;Duto maneno lokore to tho,In mak ilokori, bedi koda.
Pile achando, to adwaroi,In kendi inyalo teko mar Jachien;In kendi itera, In midemboa,E mudho be e chieng`, bedi koda.
Onge maluoro, In kibed koda,Eka masira dak oloya ngang`;Tho to ok rach; to liel onyal ang`o?An bend` aloyogi, ka In koda.
Chieng` tho inyisa kaka In nitho;Ka piny ochido polo ek` orieny;Chieng` cha noru, to mudho duto orum,Kangima, kat` atho, bedi koda.
Roho mar Nyasaye, ibina,Luok chunya obed maler;Bende parona ipwodhi,Bi, ipong` chunya koro.
Much Nyasaye, mond` ibi,Pong` chunya, asayoi;Pwodha abed ng`ati chutho,Much Nyasaye,ibi koro.
Roho mar Nyasaye, bi kuoma;Kata ok anyal neniTo adwaro mond` ibina,Bi, ipong` chunya koro.
An ayom, aonge teko,An akulorani, Ruoth;Roho mar Nyasaye maler,to Mond` imiya tekoni.
Luoka, hoya, thiedha, gwedha;Herani opong`chunya;Konya, sira, taya pile;Gwethni mond` osik koda.
Paki Nyasaye mogwedhowa.Ji duto pake e piny ka;Paki Yesu, Malaika,Paki Jakony, Muya Maler.Amin.
Wang` chieng` koro podhonwa,mudho biro imo piny;Sulwe to gi dwe koroGotieno gidendo Ruoth.
En ma JachwechNyasachwa maler ngang`,Nyasaye Maduong`;Malaika me polo,To gi dhano man e piny,Wapakoi.
In mimiyowa ngimaIn midak e polo ku,Lerni mond` omeny chunywa,Ni mondo wang`e adierKa In kodwa.
Herani obed kodwaE mudho mar otieno;Ka nindo oterowa,Jopolo mondo ritwaNyaka ru piny.
Kendo chieng` kiduogo, Ruoth,Gi teko mar kawo pinyruoth,Nyasacha asayoi,Ruaka kanyo ma Intie,Polo malo.
Ji duto te mondo giwerka gipako Jawar,Ka gipako Jawar;Gipak duong` marRuoth Nyasachwakod ng`uonone maduong`.
Ruodha maduong` gi Nyasachakonya mondo ahul;Konya mondo ahulDuong` mar Nying Ruothgi JawarnaE kuonde duto te.
Yesu en nying makelo mor,Ogolo kuyowa;Ogolo kuyowaEn wer mamit ni jarichoEn ngimana kod kuwe.
Oketho teko mar richoOgonyo jomotwe,ogonyo jomotwe;Rembe nyalo luoko richoRembeno nochwerna.
Ang`eyo Yesu osewaraKuom herane gi ng`wonone;E nengo mochulo e thone,Omiya bedo nyathine.
Osewara! Yesu owara gi rembe;Osewara! Asebet nyathine chutho.
Amor nikech Ruoth osewara;Onge dhum ma dahul godo,Herano ma an go e chunya,ka koro Yesu dak koda.
Ageno neno Ruodha Yesu;E duong`ne gi berne duto;Otayo tienda e wang` yore,Oketo chikne e chunya.
E dala maler mar Nyasachwa;Osimb ngima oritoa;Chieng` moro kobiro gi duong`ne,Eka nabed kode polo.
Wuo gi chunya,Ruoth Yesu,Wuona gi dwol mamuol,Kiwachona gi ng`wono,"Ok idong` kendi ngang`;"Yaw chunya mond` awinji,Awinj dwondi piyo;Mi chunya mond` opaki,Kamor kuomi chutho.
Wuona gi dwol mamuol chuth,kinyisa herani;Ni mondo alo richoKawauotho kuom Roho;Wuo koda ndalo duto,Wuona gi dwol mamuol;Ageno singruok mari:"Ok idong` kendi ngang`."
Wuo gi nyithindi pile,Tergi e yo maler;Pong`gi gi mor gi ilo,Puonjgi rito galam;Mondo giwalni chunygi,Kod ngimagi duto,Ru biro mar pinyruodhi,Mondo waneni, Ruoth.
Wuo koda kaka chon chaNiwuoyo gi jogi;Nyisa gino Midwaromondo atini, Ruoth;Ni mondo amak chikni,Kendo amiyi duong`;E ngimana gi wuodhamond` apaki pile.
E loka nam mopogo kindPiny chandruokni kod gik mak ne,Nitie pinyno ma ok norumKa ma pi, wang` noywe duto.
E loka nam e nam mogingore,Awinjo duond Jawarna ka luonga;Ndalo chiegni mawanawe chandruok,Mawanadag gi Ruoth manyaka chieng`
E loka nam e dho wadh kuweKama richo duto norum ;Kama chandruok ok nobedieTiende mool noyud yweyo.
Onge paro gik mokadhoChunya mool noyud teko;Pi wang`wa ok nochwer kendoWenge mool none Jawar.
E loka nam kar kuwe gi morYesu luongo nyithinde te;E loka nam parruok norumMalaika wero wend ruak.
Analu bang` YesuNyarombo Nyasaye,Noluoka gi rembemosechwer;Hera mare e momiyo`thonwa ka,Noluoka gi rembemosechwer.
Noluoka gi rembe,Enoluoka gi remb Nyarombo;Kata Kethruok diche chunya manade,Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer.
Analu bang` Yesu Kristo Jakonywa,Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer;Rembe e moromo mana ji duto,Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer.
Analu bang` Yesu Kristo jagwethna,Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer;Enoyie ni mond` adonji e polo,Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer.
Kethna duto ni mond`ahul ni Nyasaye,Noluoka gi remb Yesu Wuode;Mondo miya ngimanema nyaka chieng`,Noluoka gi rembe mosechwer.
Nitie ngima kwang`iyo msalaba;Yesu wacho, "Ng`iyauru."Mwandu mar piny en gi mokadho,Mwandu mosiko ni kuom Ruoth Yesu.
Kwang`iyo, nitie ngima,Ka wang`iyo msalaba.Wanayud warruok chutho,Kwang`iyo yor Kalwari.
Ka nakwongo ng`iyo wang` Jawarna,Nong`iyoa gi wang` mang`won;Kendo ka temruok dwaro loya,Nayud teko kang`iyo msalaba.
Nang`i msalaba ndalona duto,Kageno singruok mar Nyasaye;Satani ok onyalo loyoJogo mageno teko mar polo.
Wapaki, Nyasaye,In miherowa ngang`!Nioro Wuodi mond`othonwa e yath.
Wapaki, Nyasaye,nikech Roho Maler.Osefwenyonwa heramar Jawarwa.
Pak duto obed niNyarombo Nyasaye,Ma noting`o kethwa,rembe nochwernwa.
Pak duto obed ni,Nyasaye, Wuon ng`wono,Ma noresowa kendooritowa.
Chiew chunywa duto,pong`wa gi herani;Mach moa e poloomi chunywa liet.
Kat` abed jaketh maduong`,Remb Yesu nochwer ni an;Nothona ni kik atho,To adag kode polo;Asiki but Jawarna,An ng`ate, to En Ruodha.
Hera Yesu duong` chutho,Onyiso polo malo,Tut moloyo nam matut,Osiko ma nyaka chieng`,Herane noywayoa,Nogola e mudho ka.
Kat` abed jaketh maduong`,Kristo oseng`wonona;Dwarona kod kuyona,Mago duto ong`eyo;Okonya e lwenje chuny,Ngimana okan kuome.
Yesu analu bang`i,Asewinji kiluonga;Adwaro mond` itelna,Inyisa wang`yori.
Analu bang`i,analu bang`i,Analu bang`ika ma itelona.
Yesu, mak itelona,An abiro bayo yo;Ok ang`eyo wang`yori,In mondo itelna.
An kenda nanyap chutho,To di po kaol e yo;An ageno tekoni,Adwaro itelna.
Kwonde duto motelona,Anadhi nikech agene;Aparo kaka nothona,Rembe nochwer e Kalwari.
Yesu notelna pile ka,Yesu notelna yo duto;En e Osiep mageno chuth;En nothona e Kalwari.
An amor kawinjo chikne;Amor chutho kotelona;To chunya mor kuom dwarone,Kaparo thone Kalwari.
Adhiyo nyime mak aluor,Amor kuom Kristo, Jawarna;Ageno neno Osiepna,Yesu mothona Kalwari.
Yesu ka noa polomond` otho ni ji me piny,Noparo e ng`wonone,Nyithindo ka wan.
Mon nomanyo Jawarwa,Kwonde ka ma nopuonje;Ne gikelo nyithindgi,Nyithindo ka wan.
Yesu nobiro e piny,ni mond` owar jo molal;Yesu e mokonyowa,Nyithindo ka wan.
Nyithindo, hereuru,Ka utimo tich maber;Pakeuru, Yesu Ruoth,To wan nyithinde.
Kristo, In Wuon ng`wono duto,Puonj chunya mond` opaki;Gwethni ma ayudo pileMiyo chunya mor kuomi.Puonja heroi adieri,Mond` aluwi kwonde te;Muchi mondo dak e chunya,Miya genoi pile.
An apaki, In Jakonya,In mitelona pile;An kaluwo bang`i pile,Nachopi thurwa gi kuwe.Yandi Yesu to nodwaraKa nabayo yo marach;Rembe nochwer mond` owara,Noresa e kethona.
An to, an jagope chuthoKuom ng`wono motimona;Hera mari mond` otweyaAbed ng`ati chutho, Ruoth.Piny to kik oywaya kendo,Asik kuomi, yaye Jakony;Achiwoni chunya koro,Obed mari nyaka chieng`.
Onge osiepmoro kaka Yesu;En kende!En kende!Onge mathiedhotuoche mag chunywa;En kende!En kende!
Yesu ong`eyochandruokwa duto,Notelnwanyaka piny ogik;Onge osiepmoro kaka Yesu;Kat` achiel,Kat` achiel.
Onge osiepman gi duong`ka Yesu,En kende!En kende!To chunye muolmoloyo ji duto;En kende!En kende!
Onge saa moromak Entie kodwa,Kat` achiel,kat` achiel.Kata e mudhoEn kodwa pile;En kende!En kende!
To En Osiepma ok enowewa;En kende!En kende!Onge jakethma Yesu ojaro,Kat`achiel,kat`achiel.
Noherowa nyakane othonwa;En kende!En kende!Ok enojwang`nyithinde mohero,Kat` achiel,kat` achiel.
Luwo, luwo, analu bang` Yesu;Kata ka, kata ku, analu bang`e;Luwo, luwo, analu bang` Yesu;Kwonde duto motelona analu.
Ruoth Nyasacha, aneno gik miwuoro,Miseketo e pinyni mwadakie;Wang` chieng` gi due,gi sulwe man e polo,Gik moko te ma lueti noloso.
Chunya opong` gi mor kapakoi,Yaye Nyasacha, herani duong`;Chunya opong` gi mor kapakoi,Yaye Nyasacha, herani duong`.
Ka awuotho e bunge to awinjo,Winy mapaki gi duonde miwuoro;Ka abedo e gode mabor chutho,Awinjo duonde mag pige mamol.
Kaparo ni Nyasaye nochiwo Wuode,Mondo otho en wach miwuoro ngang`;E wi yadhno noting`o kethna duto,Rembe nochwer moluoko richona.
Ka Kristo nobi gi teko gi duong`ne,Nadhi kode nobed mor manade;Nakulra e nyime ka amiye duong`,Kawacho ni In Nyasacha Maduong`.
Chunya, mond` iritri,Wasigu lworoi;Gitemo loyoi pileMondo itim richo.
Ritri galam; kedi,Ni kik ogoyi piny;Kedi matek ndalo duto,Kikwayo kony Nyasaye.
Locho pod ni nyime,Rit gi lwenji maber;Tim kinda, Lweny ok enorumNyaka`iyud osimbo.
To kak abet Yesu kawa,Inyisa yo maber chutho;Abironi, iwachona,Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet Yesu yiea,Adwaro mond iluok chunya;To in iwe kethruok magaRuodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet Yesu kawa,Imiyo chunya mor pile;Ndalo duto chunya bayo,Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet ni an muofu, an ng`a modhier morem teko;In kende In Jakinda ngang`,Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet Yesu kawa,Iruaka, luoka, guda ka;Nikech ageno singruokni,Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.
To kak` abet, herani, Ruoth,Oseyawna wang`yo maler;Mondo abed ng`ati chutho,Ruodhwa Yesu, abironi.

references.title: Koro Kawuono, Ruodhwa Man E Polo

lines: Koro kawuono, Ruodhwa man e polo,oseyawo buge bura;Onono paro, weche, timbe,Kata richo, kata ber.
Wanachung` nade ndalono?Wanachung` nade ndalono?Nonwang`wa ka pod waricho,Koso kawaler kuom remb Yesu?
Tich yandi ochaki kuom jo monindo;To ndalo koro chiegini,Ma enononwa, jo mangima;To buchwa nobed nade?
Kitap Nyasachwa nonyis weche duto;E ma Jang`ad bura nosom;Kaka nong`ad bura e saano,Nosiki ma nyaka chieng`.

title: Koro Kawuono, Ruodhwa Man E Polo

lines: Abiro ni msalaba,an ayom, an ng`a modhier;Aweyo gi piny duto,Mond` akwo e msalaba.
An agenoi kende,Nyarombo mar Kalwari;Ruoth akulora ni In;Yesu Ruoth, mond` iwara.
Ayuakni koro, Jawar,Richo e moloyoa;Yesu to wacho niya,"Anawe gi duto te."
Achiwoni duto te,ngimana kod tekona;Chunya kod ringra bende,Nobed mari nyaka chieng`.
Kuom rembi manochwerna,aseluokora koro;Aweyo gombo duto,analuwi, Jawarna.
Yesu bi, ipong` chunya,mond` abed molony kuomi;Abedi maler chutho,mond` apaki nyaka chieng`.
Nitie Wendo e dhoot,dak yawne;(Dak yawne Jawa);Osebedo kanyo chon,dak yawne;Yawne ka pok okadho;Ruakeuru, Ruoth Maler,Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasaye,dak yawne.
Koro yawne, Ruodh chunyi;Dak yawne,to kideko nokadhi,Dak yawne;Ruake nikech En Osiep,kendo enorit chunyi,Enoriti nyaka chieng`,Dak yawne.
Winji dwonde kosayo;Dak yawne;En ma mondo iyiere,Dak yawne;Ochungo e dhoot oko,Orito mond` iyawne,Enomedni mor gi kuwe;Dak yawne.
Ruakuru wendo polo,dak yawne;Enotimni mor maduong`,Dak yawne;Enowenu richou,kendo twech maru nogony,Enoteru ka maler,dak yawne.
Un jowuoth, to udhi kanye?Un maneno nyima ka.Wan wadhiyo dala Ruodhwa,Wan wawuotho ku mabor.Wan wadhiyo ku mabor,to Wan wadhi ka piny moloyo;Wan wadhiyo piny mar Ruodhwa,Piny moloyo pinje te.
Nyiswa gi mudwaro yudo,Kusetundo piny maber.Wanayudi gik moloyo,Yesu madhi miyowa.Wanane Jakonywa kucha,Gi Nyasaye to wanabedi;Nyaka chieng` to wanasiki,Kwasetundo piny maber.
Un jowuoth to un uyieMondo wan wadhi kodu?Ee, biuru, kik udeki,Ber udhi kachiel kodwa.Biuru, to kik uwewa,Yesu e moruako duto;Enoyie mondo udonji,Mond` usiki piny maber.
Wang`a e maneno Nyasaye,Ita e mawinjo Wachne;Tienda e mawuotho e yorene,Dhoga e mapako duong`ne;Lueta e matiyo tichne,Chunya e maherego pile.
Kidira chieng` mar yueyo,En chieng` maler mar mor;Morunwa chieng` malong`o,Moloyo duto te;To ji ma nyaka nene,Gipako ka giwer,Maler, Maler, Maler,To Nyasaye achiel mang`won.
En chieng` maduogo chunywa,Mariembo wach malit;En puoth Nyasayemalong`o Motimo pi mokuwe;En soko mak oduono,Mochwernwa pi mang`ich;En chieng` momiwa nenoPiny ma nomiwa ku.
To tinde wach malernoOkonyo jo mojony;Nyasaye oluongo joge,Gichokore kaachiel;Giwinjo wach me polo,Ogolo richogi;Oyueyo chunygi bende,Chieng`no gimor adier.
Ok wang`eyo saaka ma Ruodhwa noduogi,Ranyisi mang`enye ma koro waneno;Wang`eyo nobi,En owuon e mowacho,To ok wang`eyo saa.
Enobi, kiyeuru gi kinda.Enobi, Alleluya! Alleluya!Malaika me polonokowe gi duong` ngang`;To ok wang`eyo saa.
Weche mag Nyasayekoro dhiyo piny duto,Lando wach ni jikuom Jawarwa Ruoth Yesu;Chunywa koro mor,ka waneno ranyisi;To ok wang`eyo saa.
Wakiye koro,teche duto wamoko;Wanati mateknyaka Ruodhwa oduogi;Wang`eyo adier,koro ndalo mag giko,To ok wang`eyo saa.
Kik ibarna, yaye Jakonya,Winji yuak mara;In Kiluongo jo mamagi,Mond` iluonga be.
Yesu, Yesu,Winji yuak mara;In Kiluongo jo mamagi,mond` iluonga be.
An kaparo ng`wono marichunya yudo kuwe;Ka agoni chonga piny ka,Jawarna, Konya.
An ageno nyingi kende,Adwaro neni;Changi chunya moseketho,Wara gi rembi.
Miwaso ohewa kodi,To agombi nga`ng;Ere ng`a maromo kodiE piny gi polo?

references.title: Ruodha Dak Ipogna Kuon Mar Ngima

lines: Ruodha, dak ipognakuon mar ngima,Kaka nipogo kuonni jo machon;Asomo Wachni, Ruoth,kadwaroi;Chunya ogomboi,Wach Mangima.
Gwedh Wachni, koro Ruoth,masewinjo;Kaka nigwedho kuonni jo machon;Pidha gi Wach mari,ayud teko;Eka nayud kuomikonyruok duto.
Wecheni gin ngima,Miwachona;Adwaro timogito an ayom,In kende, konyruokna;In ngimanakawinjo wachni,Ruoth nalo lwenj chuny.

title: Ruodha Dak Ipogna Kuon Mar Ngima

lines: Ruoth, kwagoni chongwa piny ka,Gwedhwa te ka pok wake;Pwodhwa, gudwa, luokwa chutho,Bi, dak e chunywa duto.

references.title: In Migeno Chamo Mwandu Me Polo

lines: In migeno chamo mwandu me polo,Nang`o inindo kichiegni chopo?Chiew chunyi koro,twe gi lwenji duto;Tim kinda, to ndalo kadho piyo.
In migeno chamo mwandu me polo,Nang`o igalri kichiegni donjo?Chungi iikri, Jawarwa obiro;Iromne kolor e boche polo.
Timbe mag pinynikik mond` olomb chunyi;Duto mag piny kadho kendo rumo;Chod oko gigo mosetweyo chunyi,Kigeno chopo kawo gikeni.
Wang`i kik riwni,to mond` ing`i malo,Kikiyo biro mar Ruodhwa maduong`;Ndalono chiegni, lerne dwaro neno;Waikre mar romo kod Ruoth gi mor.

title: In Migeno Chamo Mwandu Me Polo

lines: Ruoth, ok akwayoi tindeweche mag kiny;Rita kuom richo duto tetinendeni;Dhoga kik opus wach moroMa ok long`o;In mond` ibed Jarit dhogatinendeni.
Adwaro tiyoni matekkachiel galam;Konya abed mang`won e wach,gi tim bende;Miya teko mar winjoi,atim chikno;Konya kik atim dwaronatinendeni.
To kata ngimana dirumkwauononi;Mondo yuda kapadorakuom singruokni;Mit kata ok akwayoiweche mag kiny,Rita, taya, imaka, Ruoth,tinendeni.
Isedwaro yuweyo kod yie momedore,Isesayo gi chuny motur ngang`;Yuweyo ok niyud ngang` kata gweth malong`o,Nyak isechiwori misango.
Iseketo gigi te e kar Misango?Bende Roho maler teloni?Inyalo yudo gweth mibedi gi kuwe chuth;Ka ichiwone chunyi duto.
Ber iwuoth gi Ruodhi e ler manie wachne,To niyuwe e yo maber mar Ruoth,Nyak itim chik Ruodhi mond` ibed maler chuth,Gigi te nyak` ichiw misango.
Ok wanyal ng`eyo ngang` Gik ma Ruoth chiwonwa,Kuom gwethgo ma wasekwayogo,Ringrewa kod chunywa,Oneg ochik chutho, Kendo wachiw duto misango.
Ng`a ma diwach hera mobiro oronwa,Kendo chunywa nobed mamor ngang`;Mit mar wuoyo kode noromwa waduto,Kwasechiwo duto misango.
Mana kak` abet abiro,ok anyal bet maber kenda,Adwaro rembi moromayie iwara kuom ng`wononi.
Kaka abet, kaka abet abironi,O Ruoth winja, gwedha, wara ,kaka abet abironi.
Mana kak` abet ang`eyo,Rembi kende emoroma,Noluoka matar moloyokomiya genoi chutho.
Mana kak` abet abiro,chunya mool ogomboi,Ok anyal bet mabor kodi,Adwaro bet mari chutho.
Chunya gi ngimana duto,Mondo oyud yuweyo kuomi,K`ase bayo ma ase ol,Ayuweyo kuom hera mari.

references.title: An Achamo Kuon Mar Ngima Adier

lines: An achamo kuon mar ngima adier,To amodho pi mar Yesu owuon;To ng`a momodho pi kama,Riyo to ok noloye ngang`;Riyo ok noloye ngang`?Ooyo, ok noloye ngang`;Ng`a momadho pi kamariyo ok noloye ngang`;Yesu Owuon owachonwa kariyo ok noloye ngang`.

title: An Achamo Kuon Mar Ngima Adier

lines: Nitie ber kwonde duto,Ka kuwe nie dala;Nitie mor kuom dwonde te,Ka nitie hera.Kuwe kod mor ogundhonwa,Kwonde duto mor nitie;Saa bende kadho gi mor,Ka nitie hera.
Ka hera ni e ot,Saa duto kadho gi mor,Ka nitie hera.
Ji duto bedo mamor,Ka kuwe nie dala;Sin gi nyiego onge chuth,Ka nitie hera.Chuny joot te yudo kuwe,Piny obet maber kodgi;Mor nitie e ngimagi,Ka nitie hera.
Polo yudo mor maduong`Ka kuwe nie dala;Piny duto opong` gi mor,Ka nitie hera;Wer mamit ma ji wero,Ler marieny moa malo,Nyasachwa mor e polo,Ka wan kod hera.
Kabedo ng`ati chutho,Nanyis herani;Ka angima kuomi, Ruoth,Eka mor nitie;Anayue kuom kethruok te,Mak apar masich richo;Kuom ng`wononi nigwedha,Ka nitie hera.
Wuora, atang`oni lueta,In kendi kar konyruok;Ka da iweya kenda ngang`,An to dachik kanye?
Ayie koro, Ayie chutho,Ni Yesu nothona;Rembe nochwer ni mond`ayud Gonyruok e richona.
An koro ayie kuom Wuodi;Mond` ang`e tekoni;Imiya gik marem koro,Mondo ipong` chunya.
In Wuon genruok; ang`iyoiKageno konyruokni;Kik idaga, asayoi,Ayud ngima kuomi.
Ruodha telna kuom kuyo moluora,Med telona, mudho olil an mabor gi dala;Med telona ok anyal neno mabor moloyo,Yie itelna mondo alu bang`i.
Ne an mabor ne ok ageno kuomi, Koro telna;Ne ahero yiero yora awuon, koro telna;Chunya kod ringruok ne kedo lweny mager,Sunga machon ok anapar kendo.
Teko mari mosegwedha adier,Pod notelna kuom chandruok gi masiche moluora ndalo duto;Bang`e namor kod jomalaika masegombo neno ndalo duto.

references.title: Wan Wamor Kwatiyo Ni Ruoth Yesu

lines: Wan wamor kwatiyo ni Ruoth Yesu;Wan wawuok ka chunywa yie timoTich manade ma Ruodhwa ochiko,Wanatim kinda kuom tich Ruodhwa.
Tich Ruodhwa Yesu,Watiyo gi mor, watiyo gi mor;Tich Ruodhwa Yesu,Wanatine e piny ka!
Wanamor mar nyiso ji wach kuome,Kak` ohero ji duto e piny;Kristo, mobedo e duong` mar Wuoro,Ochiwo gwethne kuom ng`wonone.
Wabedo mamuol kwaluwo Ruodhwa,Kwawuotho e yo motelonwa;Jo molal wakelo ir Jawarwa,Kwanyisogi Yesu ma Jakony.

title: Wan Wamor Kwatiyo Ni Ruoth Yesu

lines: Kabedo e tiend Ruoth Yesuawinjo weche mamit;Ka maber, moneg` abedieE tiende ndalo duto.Kabedo e tiend Ruoth Yesu,Kaparo kit ngimana,Awuoro hera gi ng`wonoma Yesu otimona.

Nyinge ber moloyo,Nyingeno wageno ka;Nyinge ber moloyo(Nyinge ber, ober moloyo)Nyingeno wageno ka.

En Ruodh ruodhi wanadende,ka wagone chongwa piny;Kucha e pinyruoth mar polo,Ka wuodhwa me piny rumo.

Yesu En Osiepna moloyo; Omiya kuwe gi mor e chunya;An kapadora kuome, ok aluor gimoro ngang`,Ee, Yesu En Osiep maber ngang`.

Jarit, go tung` mar Injili,Mond` inyis ji duto wach;Ma ka ng`ato osewinjo,Olokre ni mond` okwo.

Mond` igoye e wi gode,Kendo e pewe duto;Kwonde duto, e ru ler duto,Mondo giwinj Injili.
Kendo igoye e gwenge,Kod wang`yore duto te;Mond` iland wach ni ji duto,Kaka Wuoro luongogi.
Jogo be ma ting` ohewo,Magombo yudo thuolo;Nyisgi kaka Ruoth Jawarwa,Wacho, "Biuru ira."
Wagedi e lwanda mangima,kuom Yesu lwanda mochwere;En kar Konyruokwae piny marach,ka yamb temruok okudho.
Waged e Lwanda,(Waged e Lwanda, Lwanda motegno),Waged e... Lwanda.waged e lwanda,Lwanda motegno,Kristo e Lwandano.
Moko gedo kuom kuoyo mayom,Gigeno mwandu mar pinyni;Moko ketore kuom timbe piny,kuom morne to gi gombo.
Wageduru kuom Lwanda matek,en mise ma ok nomukre;En gi migeno ma nyaka chieng`,Genruok mar warruok marwa.
In e ngimana mochweremoloyo duto me piny;E wuodha duto me piny ka,Jawar yie awuoth kodi.
Kodi Ruoth, kodi Ruoth,Kodi Ruoth, kodi Ruoth;E wuodha duto me piny ka,Jawar yie awuoth kodi.
Ok alem ne mor mar pinyni,ok alem mond` ayud dwong`;Na ti gi mor kat e chandruok,Yie mondo awuoth kodi.
Kodi Ruoth, kodi Ruoth,Kodi Ruoth, kodi Ruoth;Na ti gi mor kat e chandruok,Yie mondo awuoth kodi.
Telna e pinyni mar mudhoting`a mondo alo piny;Eka mondo adonj kodie ngima ma ok norum.
Kodi Ruoth, kodi Ruoth,Kodi Ruoth, kodi Ruoth;Eka mondo adonj kodiE ngima ma ok norum.
Winji yuakna, inyisa ng`wononi,In Jakonya, bina;Chunya motur ogombo bironi,In Jakonya, bina.
Asebayo mabor e piny malich,Asebayo mabor kodi;kawa koro, idwoka e kundi,In Jakonya bina.
Aonge kara, kata kar konyruok.In Jakonya, bina;Wang`i mang`uon miya bedo gi ler,In Jakonya, bina.
An kenda ka, to tienda ol e yo,In Jakonya, bina;Ang`iyoi, mond` ayud mor kuomi,In Jakonya, bina.
In ok nidag jalo ma chunye tur,In Jakonya, bina;Winj alamna, kendo iwinj yuakna,In Jakonya, bina.

references.title: Ka Boche Polo Oyawo E Wi Gode

lines: Ka boche polo oyawoe wi gode mabeyo,Kendo ka chieng` marienymaber osemenyo wi gode.Wanyalo somo herane,e lihudu me polo,Eka wanang`ere maber,ka rondo oserumo.

Wanang`e...re malong`o,(Wanang`e...re malong`o);Ok wana...pogre kendo,(Ok wana...pogre kendo);E saa ma...piny yaworenwa,(E saa ma...piny yaworenwa);Ka rondo...oserumo,(Ka rondo oserumo, oserumo);E saa ma...piny yaworenwa,(E saa ma piny yaworenwa);Ka rondo...oserumo,(Ka rondo oserumo, oserumo).
Ka watimo marach ka wakiani wan dhano matho,Ka waweyo chik mag ng`wonokwatemo bedo maber,Ng`wonone mar kuwe noumwa,Richowa mag ndalogi,Ka tich matek oserumo,Ka rondo oserumo.
Ka rondo oseyaworewanang`e osiepewa,Kaka wuonwa bende ong`eyonyithinde duto te;Ka ndalo maduong`no biro,koa malo yor ugwe,E chunywa duto warito,Nyaka rondo rum chutho.

title: Ka Boche Polo Oyawo E Wi Gode

lines: Nying Yesu mondo yudi pak,Ji mondo gidende;Malaika me polo ku,Miuru Ruodhu duong`.Malaika me polo kuMiuru Ruodhu duong'
Miuru Ruoth duong` e chunyu,Geneuru kende;Ting` nyinge malokuom jopiny,Miuru Ruodhu duong`.Ting` nyinge malokuom jopiny,Miuru Ruodhu duong'

Adwaro bet buti, Nyasaye Wuora;Abed buti chutho, Yesu RuodhaNdalo duto abed buti Nyasaye Wuora;Asik buti pile Nyasaye Wuora.

Duto mimiyoa kuom ng`wononi,Giywayo chunya chuth, abed buti;Nyisa wang`yo mari, en e ma mond` alu;Asik buti pile, Nyasaye Wuora.
Kendo gi tekona nadend nyingi;In Lwandana, Ruodha, In warruokna;Kata e masira, apadora kuomi,Asik buti pile, Nyasaye Wuora.
Kochier a e liel ching` bironi,Adonj ka ma Intie, Nyasaye Wuora;Nayud mor mochwere e dalani maber,Nabed buti pile, ma nyaka chieng`.
Chungi, jakristo, Ne jasiki cha;Bedi ka jachir mar Yesu,Kik iluor Satan kata tekone;Gen Yesu Kristo Gi wach Nyasaye.
A e nindo, Bedi ka jakedo;Chungi, Kedi Wanalo Satan,Kik waluore, Yesu ni jateloOseloyo lweny gi Tekone.
Kaw okumba yie, Gi ogut Konyruok,Kendo ligangla mar Muya,Kik iwe lamo ma nitekoni;Yesu okonyo askeche.
Wuothuru matek kik uol eyo;Yaluru pile wach Nyasaye.Un kuti maber, Chieng` kobiroUnubed kode e ngimane.
Yesu oluongoi mondo ibi,Oluongoi kawuononi;Nikech oneno kibayo marach,Kidhiyo mabor kode.
Oluongoi, oluongoi,Yesu (Yesu oluongoi tinde),Yesu oluongi (Kawuono ibi),Oluongi kawuono ibi.
Yesu oluongo jo mool giyuwe,Oluongou kawuononi;Kelne ting` duto machandi pile,En ok noriembi kodgi.
Yesu oriti, bi ire tinde,Oritoi kawuononi;Bi ire, nyise richoni duto;Reti, to kik ideki.
Yesu osayo, dak iwinj dwonde;Yie winj dwonde, kawuononi;Jogo moyie nyinge giniyud mor,Chungi, dhi ire piyo.
Richona diluok gang`o?Mana gi remb Yesu kende.En ang`o ma dipwodha?Mana gi remb Yesu kende.
To kuom richo magwaonge wang`yo moroMwayudogo pwodhruok,Mak mana gi remb Ruoth Yesu.
Onge gi ma dipwodha,to mana remb Yesu kende;Aonge chandruok moro,mana gi remb Yesu kende.
Ok anyal yudo winjruok,mak mana gi remb Ruoth Yesu;Bura to bwogo chunya,kaonge gi remb Ruoth Yesu.
Ma e genona kende,en e remo mar Ruoth Yesu;Aonge ber kata kuwe,mak mana kuom remb Ruoth Yesu.
Gi moromo ji duto,en remo mar Ruodhwa Yesu;Achiwo pakna duto,ni remono mar Ruoth Yesu.
Onego abed gi Yesu,Ok anyal wuotho kenda.Ka Yesu obedo butaAnyalo yudo teko.
Eka chunya ok noluor (ok noluor);Anadhi ka modwaro, (modwaro);Anadhi mapiyo piyo,Kotelona e wang`yo.
Onego abed gi Yesu,Kuom Yie mara e chunya;Wechene ohoyo chunya,Ka gimiya tekone.
Onego abed gi Yesu,E ngimana duto te;Kata an e temruok moro,kata e parruok moro.
Onego abed gi YesuE yorena duto te;Eka an anyalo chopoE dala mosingonwa.
Adwari saa duto,Yesu mang`won;Adwaro tekoni,to an ayom.
Adwari yaye adwari,Saa duto adwari;Yesu, igwedha koro,abironi.
Adwari saa duto,sudi buta;Satan ok oloya,ka an abuti.
Adwari saa duto,e mor gi tuo;To an kaonge in,anyal ang`o?
Adwari saa duto,puonja wachni;Tim kak` idwaro In,an nyathini.
Adwari saa duto,Yesu Ruodha;An ng`ati chutho,an, ndalo duto.
Puonja Injili lilo,Kuom wach polo mak ne,Kuom Yesu bende duong`ne,Gi herane adier;Puonja malong`o chuthoMondo ang`e maber,Nikech arach e nyime,Nabayo chon marach.
Puonja Injili lilo;Puonja Injili lilo;Puonja Injili lilo;Kuom hera mar Yesu.
Puonja Injili mos mos,Amak wachno mamit;Hono mar waro jopiny,Machango chuny marach;Puonja Injili pile,Kik wiya wil nono;Adwaro wach odonjna,Ahero yie adier.
Puonja Injili kare,Gi dwol mamuol chutho;To an jaketh chik polo,Yesu to waroa;Puonja Injili kende,Makonyoa maber;Mamiyo dhano kinda,Koneno wach malit.
Puonja Injili chutho,Wach maradier ayie;To mor mar piny omayoNgima mar chuny jawuoth;Eka ka piny noruna,Kachopie polo cha,Puonja Injili chutho,Kuom Yesu ma Jawar.
Chunyi dich nikech parruok,Dak imi Yesu kinde?Weche piny otweyoi,Dak imi Yesu kinde?Ne ochungo e dhootOdwong`o mond` iyawne;Winje koro kosayo-Dak imi Yesu kinde.
Saa okadhoni nono,Dak iti tich mar Yesu?Nyasaye nomiyi teko,Mond iti tich mar Yesu,Dak item loyo richo,Dak ikony jo moketho,Dwaro jogo mobayo yo,Dak iti tich mar Yesu?
In midwaro gik mag piny,Dak ipar Yesu Ruodhwa?Yaw chunyi ni tim maber,Kitiyo ni Ruoth Yesu,Mor mag piny gi mwandune,Kelo mor e chuny dhano;To ok en mor mosiko;Dak wami Yesu kinde?
Ka dwabed pot yath kende;To ok wanyag olembe.Luetewa nobed nono,Ndalo maduong` mar keyo;Onge gi mwakel chieng`no,Tichwa nobedi kayiem,Mi ok wanayud mor ngang`,Kwaromo gi Ruoth Yesu.
Richo oketho ji malit,Okelo buch Nyasaye;Doteri ka marach chutho,to Yesu gudoi.
Gene chutho! Gene chutho!Gene koro ka;En noresi! En noresi!En noresi ka.
Yesu otho nitho adier,misango mar Nyasaye;Oluoko kethni duto te,gi rembe ma nochwer.

Bi chak iwuothie koro ka,ka pod ingima in;Yesu owuon oluongoi,oluongoi adier.

Ahero wache mag Nyasaye,To gin weche mamiya mor;Gin to ginyisa yo maber,Kendo mond` awe tim marach.
Weche mamit monyisa kaKaka Yesu yande otho;Ee, notho kara ni mondoAnwang` ngima mochwere.
Adwaro yie weche dutoma Nyasaye osewenwa ka;Mondo agen hera Nyasaye,Mondo an bende ahere.

title: Ahero Ahinya Mar Chopo E Skul Mar Sabato

lines: In wang`yorwa; wabironiKwaringo keth gi tho;Kendo ng`a modwaro wuoroNyak` odware kuomi.

lines: Wuoth pod odong` marom nade?Jarit odwoko wach kama;`Otieno chiegini rumo,Piny biro mana ru.`Kik koro ibed gi kuyo,Iteg wang`i ku midhiye,Nyak` idonje pinyruodh Nyasaye,Kar ler ma nyaka chieng`.
Napenjo kendo jakedo;Nomiya wach mahoyo chuny;`Kedi matek, ibed jachir,Ndalo odong` matin.`Kik koro ibed gi kuyo,Tim kinda nyaka tich rumo;Wabiro yudo pok maberKwaseyudo locho.

references.title: Luetega Noti Tich Mar Ruoth Yesu

lines: Luetega noti tich mar Ruoth Yesu,lewa bende nahulego;Itega nowinj puonjne kende,Gi dwonda to napak Kristo.
Wabiro, wabiro,ni Yesu ma Ruoth nyithindo;Wabiro, wabiro,En oherowa.
En nomiya tiendega ariyo,mondo awuoth e yo maber;Wenge mabeyo ango bende,nasom Biblos ndalo duto.
Kendo Yesu Kristo ma Jawarwa,odwaro chunya tinende;Berna katimo tichne pile,ber kamiye ringra chutho.

Ruoth Yesu, para gi e polo malo;Ikonya ni mond` achiwrani chutho,Misango mangima, maler, malong`o;Luoka gi rembi mond` abedi mapoth.

lines: In odira mar Nyasaye,In e ndalowa mar mor;Chunye duto mor kodi,Kaka mor gi ler mar chieng`.
Mor mokuwe momiyowaohoyo chunywa adier;Okuweyo chuny e chandruok,Nyaka wanatiek wuodhwa.

Yesu Kristo En Osiepwa,En mogolo richowa;Wan wanyalo kwaye pilegi maber mwachando ka;To nikech wahero saye,ok walame pile ka,Kuwe oonge e i chunywa,eka wan wachandore.

Ne wakia wechegi, Yesu ni Jawarwa;Koro wan wamor nikech Yesu ni Jawarwa,Ne wadak e mudho chuth, ti waneno ler Nyasaye,E momiyo mudho tur, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Yaluru e piny ma ka, Yesu ni JawarwaYaluru e pinje te, Yesu ni Jawarwa;Kik wadeki, kik waling`, nyaka Yesu oduogi,Nyaka ji duto ong`e, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Jawarna to ni Yesu,En morna gi wenda;Ohoyoa gi wachne,ka chunya okuyo.
Jawarna to ni Yesu;Anapake kawer;Osiepna moro onge,moheroa ka En.

references.title: Nying Mamit E Piny Gi Polo

lines: Nying mamit e piny gi polo,Nying moloyo nying duto;Nyingno ma Nyasaye nochiwoNi Wuode mohero chuth.

Anawer kapako nyingno,gi hera mowarowa;Anapake ndalo duto,Nying moloyo nying duto.

title: Nying Mamit E Piny Gi Polo

lines: Ruoth Yesu, nithona,koro aheri;Kuom tekoni nawerichona duto;In ma Jawar mang`won,rembi nochwerna;Koro, Yesu Ruodha,aheri adier.
Aheri nikechnihera mokwongo;Niting`o richonae yadh Kalwari;Nichandori malitnikech richona;Koro, Yesu Ruodha,aheri adier.
Anaheri pilenyaka chieng` thona;Anapaki pileka pod angima;Ka ngimana norum,to pod nawachni,Koro Yesu Ruodha,aheri adier.

Ahero nyiso wechekuom gik mantie malo;Kuom Yesu to gi duong`ne,gi herane bende;Ahero poro wachnenikech gin adiera;Gimiya mor e chunyama piny ok nyal miya.
Ahero poro wechekuom Yesu ma Jawarwa;Kata e polo malonahul hera Yesu.
Ahero poro wechekuom Yesu ma Jawar;En wach mamitna chuthomoloyo gik mag piny;Ahero poro dutoma Ruoth notimona;Chunya ochuna pileni mond` ahul berne.
Ahero nyiso wachne,en wach maberna ngang`;Pile kanyiso ng`ato,omitna moloyo;Ahero nyiso jogoma pok owinjo ngang`,Kaka Yesu othonwamond` omiwa ngima.
Ahero poro wachne;kata jo mang`eyeAneno pod giherowinjo wach Ruoth Yesu;Kendo e polo malokawero wer manyien,Napor wach kuom Jawarwa,weche mahero ngang`.
Nindo kuom Yesu! En hawi!Ka ng`ato tho kogeno Ruoth;Okuwe mos kanyo e i liel,Wasigu ok nonyale ngang`.
Nindo kuom Yesu! Ma ber ngang`;Onge kuyo kata pi wang`;Onindo mos nyaka chieng`no,Ma dwond Ruoth Yesu nochiere.
Nindo kuom Yesu! Johawi!Jogo ma nochier ndalono;Ginine duong` mar Ruoth polo,Kobiro omo jo maler.
Nindo kuom Yesu! Ginichier!Ka tung` machien obiro kok;Giniyiech liete ndalono,Ginuyud ngima mosiko.
Ng`a mowinjo dwond Ruoth, oneg` oyie;Oland wachne mondo ji duto winje;Wachne mond` odhiyo e pinje duto;Ng`a mowinjo dwonde, bi.
Ka ng`ato winjo, ka ng`ato winjo,Ni mond` okow wachne nyaka giko piny;Wuonwa ma Jahera e maluongowa;Ng`a moyie mondo obi.
"Ng`a mobiro ira," Yesu wacho,"Kik odeki to mondo obi piyo.An e Yo, Adiera, kendo an Ngima;Ng`a mowinjo dwonda, bi."
Ng`a madwaro chutho, osesingone,Ng`a mobiro piyo ok nodog nono;Ng`a madwaro chutho, noyudi ngima;Ng`a moyie mondo, obi.
O Yesu, an adwaro Atini nyaka chieng`Asayi bedi buta, Ruodha ma jakonya.Ok analuor lwenj Satan ka In ibet buta;Yo maber ok aweyo ka In itelona.
Mondo ang`e in koda, Pinyni oywayoa;Aneno gik magombo, Dwonde matemoa;Wasika gi gilwora, Kendo gin e chunya;O Yesu, bi, ikonya, Mondo alo Satan.
O Yesu, isewacho duto molu bang`i,Ka ma intie e duong`ni Ginibedi bende.To Yesu, an adwaro Atini nyaka chieng`;Asayi konya pile, Ruodha ma Jawarna.
Tim kinda mar lemo,kiwuoyo kod Ruoth;Pidh chunyi gi wachne,kibedo kuome;Lalri gi jokristo,kony jogo manyap;To wiyi kik wil ngang`mar dwaro gwethne.
Tim kinda mar lemo,piny kadho piyo;Ket kinde mar bedoapanda kod Ruoth;Ting` wang`i kuom Yesu,ilu e ndache,Mi timni nonyis jikichalo kode.
Tim kinda mar lemo,Ruoth oteloni;Kik iring e nyime,to kik idong` chien;E mor kata chandruok,lu Yesu pile;Chom wang`i kuom Yesu,kigeno wachne.
Tim kinda mar lemo,chunyi okuwe mos;Yie Yesu chik chunyikuom paro maler;To Roho notelnikuom hera mare,Noiki ni tichnee polo malo.
Weruru weche mag Nyasaye,weche mamit mag ngima;Som giuru pile pile,weche mamit maber.To gipuonjowa niya,ni mondo wagen Yesu.

To kik wamung` ni ji me piny,weche mamit mag ngima;To gin weche makonyogi,weche mamit maber.Yesu Ruoth ma Jawarji,nopwodh chunygi gi wachne.

lines: Yesu, In ma Jahoch mar chuny,Rita gotieno kanindo;Bedi koda gotienoni,Nyaka piny chak oyawrena.
Ka pok anindo apariKaka ihera pile ka;Tich Satani aseyo chuth,In Nyasaye kende madalami.
Rita gotieno, godiechieng`,Ok dabed mangima mak In;Bedi koda ka piny olil,To daluor tho da onge In.
Kaa e nindo, Igwedha;Dhi koda ka ma adhiye;Pile kamano nyak` ibiOmo jogi moseyiei.

title: Yesu, In Ma Jahoch Mar Chuny

lines: Nyasaye ni lerna, koro ok aluor!E mudho , e chieng`, to En koda pile;Owara e kethruok, ohoyo chunya;Amor gi Yesu moherowa kama.
Nyasaye ni lerna, morna gi wenda;Otelona pile e piny ka marach;Nyasaye ni lerna, morna gi wenda;Otelona pile e piny ka marach.
Nyasaye ni lerna, e chandruok duto,Kata ok anene, chunya ogene;Mudho mar Satani ok anoloyaKa Yesu obedo koda.
Nyasaye ni lerna, kendo tekona;Ang`eyo e tekono anyalo lo;Oumo yomna gi duong` mare;Kawuotho gi Yesu koro ok aluor.
Nyasaye ni lerna, adware kende;Mudho onge chutho ka an kod Yesu;Koro En Jawarna, bende Jakonywa,Gi Malaika anapake pile.
Ang`eyo Wuonwa ong`eyo,yembe madigeng` wang` yora;To onyalo riembo mudho,komiya ler marieny chutho,Komiya ler marieny chutho.

Ang`eyo Wuonwa ong`eyo,yath madikuwena rem mara;Komula gi luete maler,nochangi chunyani matuwo,nochangi chunyani matuwo.
Ang`eyo Wuonwa ong`eyo,ayom ok anyal wasika;Kendo nojuka kuom tichna,kendo norita nyaka chieng`,Kendo norita nyaka chieng`.

Nyaka nageno remonoMochwer e Kalwari,Apako hera mar Jawar,Moherowa kama.Moherowa kama,Moherowa kama;Apako hera mar Jawar,Moherowa kama.
Ruoth, kat` an ng`amarach kama,Kuom ng`wononi maduong`Isewara, ilosona,Kar bet ma nyaka chieng`.Kar bet ma nyaka chieng`,Kar bet ma nyaka chieng`Isewara, ilosona,Kar bet ma nyaka chieng`.
To kisechiera a e liel,Miresa a e pinyAnapaki pile gi wer,Kuom mar miwarago.Kuom war miwarago,Kuom war miwarago;Anapaki pile gi wer,Kuom war miwarago.
Aparo tinendekuom pinyno miwuoro,Ma anachopie kachieng` podho;Kachungo but Jawar,kosidhna osimbo,Norieny gisulwe maler koso?
Koso sulwe nobedie osimbona,Ka ngimanamepinyni rumo?Kachiew gi hawimar bedo e yueyoni,Sulwe norienye osimbona?
Kuom teko mar Jawarmond` ati kend` alem,Mond` atim rito ka jalok ji;Ni mondo awinj dwondRuodha kowachona,"Bi, idonj e morna koro."
Nobed mor manadeka aneno wang`e,Ngimana anaket e luete;Sulwe nobedna duong`e dala dhahabu,Ka ma nayudie gwethnyaka chieng`.
Walamo Nyasaye tinde,Ka wabiro nyime ka;Tinende waweyo tich,Ni mondo Nyasaye gwedhwa;Ka wapako nyinge ka,Nobedi mana kodwa;Ka wapako nyinge ka,Nobedi mana kodwa.
Kaka Ruodhwa yandi chon,ka nosetieko tichne,Nobiro e Sabato,Wabiro bende koro;Wan waparo ng`wonone,kak` omiyowa ngima;Wan waparo ng`wonone,kak` omiyowa ngima.
Kata koro wadiro,Kaka En nochikowa,Chieng`no wanadir kuno,Kama wanane Ruodhwa;Eka wanabed gi kuwe,Bende kethruok wanawe;Eka wanabed gi kuwe,Bende kethruok wanawe.
Injili mari mondoOmak chuny jo maricho;Omed teko ni jonyawo,Okony jo machandore;Kamano wanayud gwethniNdalo duto nyak` ibi;Kamano wanayud gwethniNdalo duto nyak` ibi.
Wa winjo mar dala Nyasaye,E piny maber kendo manyien;Wawuoro kaka enobed,To wagombo bedo kanyo!Nitie wang`yo mar dhahabu,Kod udi madongo kucha;Kar bet ma Yesu olosoNi jogo duto magene.
Kanyo richo onge chutho,Masira gi temruok bende;Gi ma dimi chunywa kuyoOnge kuro dala Nyasaye.Ji nobed gi chuny mar hera,Giniyud osimb dhahabu,Bende lewni marachere,Ma Yesu norwakgo joge.
Ruoth Yesu, los chunywa maler,Ni mondo wadonj e polo;Wadwaro neno dalano,Koa e polo kuom Nyasaye,Moikore ka miaha,Kolosore chuth ni Ruodhe;Wanamodhi pi mar ngima,Ma Ruoth ose loso kanyo.
Mago ma wang` pok oneno,yit bende to pok owinjo,Ma chuny dhano pok oparo,Nyasaye oloso ni joge.Watimuru kinda koro,nyaka chieng` ma Yesu nobi;Wadonji e pinyno maber,Wadag kod Yesu nyaka chieng`.
Ne litna ka richona nokelo tho,Kendo kanaywak e bugo mar richo;Ruoth nowinja gi e bugo matutno,Modemba, ogola, moketa e mor.
Nogola e bugo mar richo,nochunga e wi Lwanda resruok;Oketo wer e chunya koro,Wend pak mamit, Alleluya!
Noketa ewi Lwanda bute chutho,Nosira motegno mond` asik kanyo;Ok naluor podho kasiko e lwete,Nagen kuom ng`uonone nyaka ayud locho.
Nomiya wer mamit ne en wer mar pak,Odiechieng` gotieno anawer wendno;Chunya nigi ilo amor an thuolo,Anapak Jawarna ma oseresa.
Anawer ng`uonone miwuoro kuoma,Anapake nyaka jii none berne;Anawer wend warruok kuonde duto te,Nyaka ji mang`eny noyie kuom Nyasaye.
In Kiol nikech chandruol e chunyi,Dhi inyis Yesu parruokni duto;Onge osiep moro kaka Yesu,Dhi inyis Yesu kende.
Dhi inyis Yesu chandruokni duto,En e Osiep migeno;Kata richo osepong`o chunyi,Dhi inyis Yesu Kende.
Kata mirima ohingo chunyi,Dhi inyis Yesu parruokni duto;Ting` mapek kodwaro loyo chunyi,Dhi inyis Yesu Kende.
In kiluoro chandruok gi masiche,Dhi inyis Yesu parruokni duto;Kik ichandori ni gi mabiro,Dhi inyis Yesu kende.
Ka luoro mar tho obwogo chunyi,Dhi inyis Yesu parruokni duto;Kidwaro bedo e pinyruodh polo,Dhi inyis Yesu kende.
Ka iol gi ting`o chandruok richo;Ruak Yesu Jawar e chunyi;Ka idwaro chako ngima manyien,Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.
Ko-ro we paruok chutho,ko-ro we kwede kendo,Koro yawne dhod chunyi,yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.
Ka ikuyo nikech richo magi,Ruak Yesu Jawar e chunyi;Soko mar Puodhruok iyudo kuome,yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.
Ka nitie temruok motamo chunyi,Ruak Yesu Jawar e chunyi;Ka en tem ma pinyni ok onyal golo,Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.
Ka osiepni machon oweyi,Ruak Yesu Jawar e chunyi;Pim osiep Yesu gi mago machon,Yie Yesu e chunyi.
Ka diher wero wend jomolocho,Ruak Yesu e chunyi;Ka diher donje dala mar yueyo,Yie Yesu donj e chunyi.
Ko-ro aweyo parruok,Ok anakwede kendo;koro ayawo chunya,kendo Yesu donje chunya.
Wamor kwaromo kod osiepe;E piny ma mwalo ni;To chunywa kuyo ka waparo;Wabiro pogore.
Ok wanapogre e polo,Ok wanapogre ngang`;E piny maberno wanamor,Ok wanapogre ngang`.
E pinyni tho opogowa kod;Osiepe mwahero;Wamor kwageno wananegi,E piny maber manyien.
Kucha ok wanawachi chutho;Wach moro mar pogruok;To mor gi kuwe nobed e chunywa,Pile ma nyaka chieng.
Bende ipuonjo ji wach Nyasaye, gokinyi ka pod wang` chieng` nitie?Bende ipuonjo ji wach Nyasaye, owadwa e saa ma chieng` rieny makech.
Keyo koro kayo machiegni, (machiegni)Kendo tich keyo biro rumo, (rumo chuth).Keyo mari nobed nade chieng`noMa Ruoth choko keyo mar jotich duto.
Bende ipuonjo ji wach Nyasaye, gotieno ka piny oling` malich?Bende ipuonjo ji wach Nyasaye owadwa ne keyono madwong`maber.
Bende ipuonjo ji wach Nyasaye gi yorno maji nyalo winjo?Mond` ichok cham maber chieng` keyono,kawuono tim winjruok kod Ruoth Yesu.
To pakuru Ruoth me polo malo;Weruru maber: ohero adier;En lwanda mageno, Makonyo duto;Mosiko mochwere, mipako chutho.
To paruru piny, en hono maduong`,Gi nam, kodi yien, gi gode kod lum;Wawuoro ngang` rieko maloso kama;wapako Nyasachwa manyisowa ma.
Gik moko me piny onyisowa ma,Nyasachwa oduong`, oler adiera;Oherowa duto gotieno gokinyi;Omiyowa ngima, orito mang`won.
Jo malaika gipako mamor,Jatelo maduong` mohero jopiny;To wan jo mireso wadende maber,Wapaki adiera kama nyaka chieng`.
Wakwayi, Ruoth, kuom tekoniMa jogi chon nobedogo;Ma nojiwo chunygi chutho,Nokonyogi dhil e chandruok.
Ere muya ma nomiyoIbrahim chir kuom chung` matek;Ma notego chuny Paulo be,Kopong`e gi teko maler.
Miwa tekoni, kaka chonElija noyudo teko;Nonenore kuom Musa be,Nojiwo Ayub e temruok.
Par ndalogo machon, Ruodhwa,Chiw teko kendo jiw tichni;Kendo ka chunywa paroiMond` iol Rohoni kuomwa.
Nyasaye, wachungo ka wawer kae,Ni mondo igwedhwa ka pok wadhi;Wadwaro lami, ka wan nyimi ka,Ka wagochongwa lamoi gi kuwe.
Miwa kuwe mari ka wadhi koro,Chako gi tieko inibed kodwa,Dhowa moselami e odi ni,Kik gol weche makelonwa wich kuot.
Miwa kuwe mari ka wan e pinyni,Kata wakuyo kata chunywa lit;In kende In gi wach mahoyowa;Nyasaye wageni, wan duto man ka.
Koro Nyasaye waparoi tinde,Ka koro wasewinjo wach mamit;Konywa ni mondo wamak wecheni;Kik Satan mawa kata wach achiel.
Singruok maber ngang`ni jogo moyie,"Abiro mapiyomar omo joga;Rituru mabernyaka abiro;Ayulwang` kik teru;timuru kinda."
"Rituru maber,nyaka abiro;Namiu pinyruoth;"Mano singruokne;"Donji e morna,bed e kom-duong`na,Nasidhnu osimbo;timuru kinda."
Wamok techewa,waritre galam;Nobi ka jakuoni jo ma ok rite;Ranyisi yangokaka ochiegni,To wakiya ndalo;ber watim kinda.
Mano genowamondikie Wachne;Kaka Ruodhwa Yesunobi gi duong`ne;Wachni oriwosingruokne duto;"Neuru, abiro;timuru kinda."
Be an jarit msalaba,jalup mar Nyarombo?Ok dak aluor wuoth`e tichnekata luongo nyinge?
Wanageng` temruoknyaka wachopi ireWanageng` temruoknyaka wanagow loka.
Oneg` adhiyo e polo,gi kuwe mogundho chuth,Ka jomamoko to kedoe dier namno mar tho?
Aneno wasigu `luora,donge dachop kucha,Pinyni orach onge ng`wonomaditera ka Ruoth.
Adier naked mond` ayud lochRuoth named jiwora,Ok anadew chwat kata litkayiengora kuomi.
Ka Yesu ochoko ji duto,kokelogi duto nyime;Eka wanabedi manade,Kwachokore winjo buchwa?
Enool bende duto e deche,kendo lito duto enowang`;Eka wanabedi manade,ndalono mang`ongo mar chier?
Wanawinj dwond Yesu Jawarwa,kowacho: "Biuru ira;"Koso wanaluor moloyo,kowacho: "Auru kuoma?"
Nomor ka oneno nyithinde,moseruako nanga maler;To ginisiki gi Jawargi,enobedi Ruodhgi maber.
Koro wanarit Yesu Kristo,kwaiko chunywa wan duto;Kobiro noyiewa ni rombe,ok nowitwa oko ka diek.
Ber waritre kwakiyo Ruodhwa,teche mondo siki kaliel;Ka wuodhwa e pinyni orumo,wamor gi Ruodhwa nyaka chieng`.
Wachokore gi mor tinde, kidira mar Nyasaye;Gi mor bende wawer nyimi kwapako nyingi ka.
Ot kama jogi lamoi Onego bed malerChuny ji mosayi odi ni Ilosogi maber.
Muya Maler, Jakony mang`won, Dak ie kanisa ni;Teche liel saa duto Te Komenyo e piny.
Nyasaye man malo, miwa mor Nyaka chunywa oyieng`,A waneni Wang` gi wang`, Kwamor ma nyaka chieng`.
Ruodha, ok agomb moko, kata mwandu mar piny;To adwaro ni mondo achopi e polo;E kitapi mar Ngima, Yesu mond` inyisa,Kata nyinga ondiki e kitapi kanyo.
Ondik nyinga koso, e kitapi maler?E Kitapi mar Ngima, nyinga nitie koso?
An gi richo mang`eny ngang`, machalo gi kuoyo;Kata kamano, Ruodha, Rembi e moromo;Nikech isesingo ni kata gibed makwar,Ginibedi matar ngang`, moloyo pe matar.
Yaye, dalano maber ngang`, man gi udi marieny,Kanyono jo modakie nigi nengni matar;Jomalaika nitie e dala malerno;Nyinga bende ondiki, e kitapi koso?
Nyasachwa man malo,Wuon teko dutoOnge teko moromak tekone adier;Onge ng`ato moromiporo go Nyasaye.En Ruoth ruodhi, beNyasach nyiseche.
Hera mar Nyasachwa,Hera adieriEn nooro Yesunikech noherowa;Ne Yesu othonwamondo kik walal ngang`,To wanaherekak` owinjore.
Ng`wono mar Nyasachwa,ng`wono mochwere;Oloso ji duto,okonyogi pile;Kik wacha Nyasachwa,to wamiye duong` chuth,En Wuon ng`wono,gi hera, gi teko.
Asebayo mabor kodi Ruodha, koro abironi,Adwaro mondo abed e ritni, koro abironi.
Koro adwogo Ruoth ee adwogo, Ruoth adwogo dala;Koro adwogo, Ruoth ee adwogo, Ruoth adwogo dala.
Aol gi piny kod richo mogundho kor` adwogo dala;Ayie Jawar norwaka e kunde kor` aduogo dala.
Ang`eyo Jawar nomiya yweyo kor` adwogo dala;Adwaro keto chunya e lwete kor` aduogo dala.
Ayie tiyoni ka ng`ama jachan kor` adwogo dala;Adwaro nwang`o ng`wono mar Jawar kor` adwogo dala.
Pakuru Ruoth, aneno Jawarna kor` adwogo dala;Orito rwako jomolal ka an kor` adwogo dala.
Bi ka Yesu,bi ka Yesu,Bi ka Yesu koro;Koro ini bika Yesu,Bika Yesu koro.
En Jakonyi,En Jakonyi,En Jakonyi koro;Koro En onyalo konyi,Bika Yesu koro.
En gi teko,En gi teko,En gi teko koro;Yesu En onyalo duto,Bi ka Yesu koro.
In kidware,In kidware,In kidware koro;Yesu koro bendo dwari,Bi ka Yesu koro.
Sae koro,Sae koro,Sae Yesu koro;Yesu ruako joma saye,Bi ka Yesu koro.
En owinji,En owinji,En owinji koro;Yesu koro winjo duto,Bi ka Yesu koro.
En oluoki,En Oluoki,En oluoki koro;Rembe emoluoko chunyi,Bi ka Yesu koro.
Gene Kende,Gene kende,Gene kende koro;Bi ire to kik ideki,Bi ka Yesu koro.
Nitie piny moro maber chutho;Koroni pod wanene gi chien;Nyasachwa oritowa kanyo,Olosonwa kar dak e polo.
Wanamor nyaka chieng`,Wanamor kwatundo e polo;Wanamor nyaka chieng`,Wanamor kwatundo e polo.
Wanawer e polo nyaka chieng`,Wer mamit mar jogo molocho;Kendo chunywa ok none kuyo,Kata chandruok moro nyaka chieng`.
Ruoth Nyasachwa ong`won gilalaWagoyone erokamano,Nikech wuode ma nochiwonwa,To gi gwethne mosemiyowa.
Koro ka wachokore,Ni mondo wahing Yesu,Wanapar Yesu Kristo,Wanayiee gi chunywa;Koro wahingo Yesu,Ma notho e Kalwari.
Ka wachamo mkate ni,Kawamadho kikombe ni,Wanahing ringre JawarMa nogur e yath ni wan;Wanahing remb Ruoth Yesuma nochwer e Kalwari.
Nyasachwa, ornwa Muchi,mondo donji e chunywa;Koro wahingo Wuodi,kaka En notho niji,Kaka rembe nochwernwa,Ka notho e Kalwari.

references.title: Ase Chop` E Piny Mar Mwandu

lines: Ase chop` e piny mar mwandu,Ma pithne nwang`ore nono;Kawuono chieng` orieny maler,Manyiso ler manyaka chieng`.
O piny maber, piny maber ngang`,Kang`iyo gi e wi godi,Ka wang`a kadho e wi nam`Aneno dhowath maber ngang`,Ka ma ilosonae kar daknamochwere e polo.
Jawar biro wuotho koda,Bende sawo wachamo ngang`,Otelona mos kod luete,Ni kech ma e polo maler.
Mo mang`we ng`ar owirago,ma tikne a e yadh ngima,Ma thiepege ok nyal nur ngang`,Ma `och ngima molie pile.
Yamb imbo ma biro ira,Dwond wer mamit okelona,Kaka malaika maler werower mamit mar warruok.

title: Ase Chop` E Piny Mar Mwandu

lines: In skul marwamar SabatoIn ka maler chutho;Chunya korogombo ywayaMondo abi iri.
Ka maler (maler),Ka maber (maber),Ka maler (maler),Ka maler (maler)Chunya korogombo ywayaMondo abi iri.
Chunya oyudo mor chuthoE skul mar SabatoKasomo wachmar Ruoth YesuKaka nosethona.
Yesu Ruodhaman gi hera,Oluongoa mondoAdhi e skulmar SabatoMond` achiwne chunya.
E chunya, e chunya,Donji e chunya, Ruoth Yesu;Donji koro, ibed koda;Donji e chunya, Ruoth Yesu.
Un muhero Ruodh polo,Weruru kuwuotho ka;Wendewa omedo duong`Ni Yesu ma Jawarwa.
Wan wadwaro piny maber,Kaka kwerewa machon;Yesu e motelonwa,Obedo Jakwath mang`won.
Kik waluor masiche wuoth,thurwa koro chiegini;Wanane Jatelowa,Ok nowewa nyaka chieng`.
Wuothuru, Jowetewa;Kik wariwre e wang`yo;Yueyo to oritowa,Wanacham mwandu kuno.
Jokeyo ni kanye mondo tim tichMar kayo cham maber e piny marach?Pand keyo en adier mar Wach Nyasaye,To yueyo onge nyaka tich rumo.
Ere jokeyo? Ng`a ma nobiNi mond` oriwre e tich maber ni Ruoth?Ng`a ma nokonywa timo tichniMar kayo cham maber e puoth Ruoth?
Dhiuru udwargi e mier duto;Cham maber nitie kata buya ng`eny;Timuru teko, moro kik lalnu;To chokuru duto e mor mar Ruoth.
Puothe koro chiek kwonde duto te;Koro tich mar keyo oritowa;To jokeyo nok, kendo tich duong` ngang`;Kwatimo samuoyo cham biro lal.
Biuru koro, un yawuot dhano,Tiuru kanyakla mar choko cham;Tiuru matek nyaka Ruoth biro,Eka unudonji e mor mar Ruoth.
An to amor ngang`,Wuonwa me polo;Ohero nyithinde duto e piny;Onge moro maromo herane,Hera Nyasaye e moloyo duto.
An amor ngang`, to Yesu `hera,Yesu `hera, Yesu `hera;An amor ngang`, to Yesu `hera,Yesu oheroa.
Ka wiya wil kendo ka aruenyo,Pod ohera kendo oluonga;To anaduog ir Ruoth Jakonya,Kahingo ka Yesu oheroa.
Hera e momiye tho Kalwari,Hera e momiye manyowa ka;Chieng` moro wanawer wer e polo,Kaka ne Yesu ohero jopiny.
Kaparo yath mar Kalwari,Ka ma Ruodhwa Yesu notho,Akwano mwandu ka nono,Anego sunga mar chunya.
Ruoth, kik iyie mond` apakraMak kuom tho Kristo Nyasacha;Gik ma nono maywayoaAchiwogi kuom remb Yesu.
Kuom wiye, luetene, tiende,Rembe nochwer koherowa;Noyie malit nikech jopiny,Notho mond` omiwa ngima.
Da piny duto obed mara,Dobed mich ma ok dak nyal rom;Hera maduong` kama noyud chunya,Ringra, ngima duto.
Keduru , Jo ka Yesu,Jokedo mag Kristo;Keluru kuodi magu,Makuru tong` gi luth.Yesu Jageng`a marwa,Otelonwa maber;Weuru luoro duto,Keduru ka mager.
Keduru, jo ka Yesu,Wasigu marwa kwiny;To Yesu En kokonywaWanyalo loyo en;Satani ni wasiguMadwaro negowa;To ka walu bang` YesuWabiro hewo en.
Keduru, jo ka Yesu,Ndalo odong` matin;Tinde wadhi kedo,Kiny wadhi weyo lwenyMohewo e moyudoE polo gik mathoth;To nyaka chieng` e polo,Osiko kodi Ruoth.
Ka chandruok osudo machiegni kodi,Ka yo man e nyimi otimo mudho,Nitie ler mogwedhi man kuom Ruoth Yesu,Monego ing`i mondo ilo temruok.
Ne ler Yesu kaka orieny maler,Ler mogwedhi mariembo luoro;Ng`i wang` Yesu mudho noringiGen Yesu kende nikech en machiegni.
Kata ok ing`eyo tiend ting`ni mapek,Mosechandi e ngimani e piny ka;Mond` iting` msalapi e chandruok duto,Kendo igen Yesu ndalo duto te.
Dhi nyime kuom yie mondo ilo temruok,King`eyo ka Jawar ni buti pile;Kata ka lweny tek to kik chunyi oa,Jawar nokonyi mondo ilo temruok.
Kata lweny ger chutho, kata kuyo thoth,Kata temruok duong` machiegni hingoi;Ruoth ni buti pile nomiyi teko,Mar loyo temruok duto mabironi.
Kik ibadhri ni tich,tijno moneg` itim;Ikri mondo itika ma onyisoi;Ruodhwa oluongoi,oluongoi pile;Yie mond` iwinj dwonde,itine gi chunyi.
Bi koro (tinde),kik idagi biro;Bi koro (tinde),ikri mondo iti;Kik ibadhri ni tich,Ruodhwa di po dwoki,Nichayo herana;ok nidonj e polo.
Kik ibadhri ni tich,Ruoth oluongi tinde;Kik idage kendo,reti iwinj dwonde;Puothe to osechiek,jokeyo e manok;In, yaw chunyi koro,mondo iti ni Ruoth.
Kik ibadhri ni tich,kik ideki koro;Kichayo herane,di po koweyi chuth;Ka pod nitie ng`wonomanyisi yor polo.Yesu pod osayi,Bi mond` oweni keth.
Yesu Kristo osechier, Alleluya!Dhano, Malaika wer, Alleluya!Wer mar mor kod wend locho, Alleluya!Polo wer be piny duoko, Alleluya!

lines: Gin weche mamit ma Jakristo owinjo,Kowuotho e piny marachni;Ndalo dong` matinnyaka Ruoth Yesu nobi,Kobiro chungo pinyruodhe.

Wawer "Alleluya"kwadendo Ruoth Yesu;Wabed jo madieri chutho;Kwarito gi kinda nyaka Ruodhwa nobi,Nosidhnwa osimbo maber.

title: Gin Weche Mamit Ma Jakristo Winjo

lines: Yesu nobi kendo mondo oom joge;Eka joge maler duto nobed kama Entie.Un kik ukul wiu, to ng`iuru malo;Nobi gi duong` modhiero ngang`,Yesu Ruoth warruokwa.
Piny noyiengni kendo, polo noa kare,Mi jo mak ler nobed nade e ndalono maduong`?Gionge kar ringo ka piny nobed malich,Mirimb Nyasaye nonere ka ng`wono oserumo.
Wang`e maliel ka mach notiek jo maricho;Onge lep ma nowach nyinge kayiem e ndalono;Onge ng`a ma nonyier Jokristo e chieng`no;Alam gi yuak mag jodong piny nobed kayiem chieng`no.
Ngima machiek mawango,chalo gi pot yath malwar,Chalo g`oboke matop,ret piyo;Ndalo nyiso wa adierni ng`wono chiegni rumo,Ng`wono nyalo rumoniret piyo.
Ret piyo,Ret piyo;Ka duond Yesu luongiiRet piyo,Kisikori e richo,Niyud dhoudi kolorTo yuakni nobed kayiemRet piyo.
Thiepe mag piny biro lal,joma tindo biro ti,Ok in gi kinde malach,Ret piyo,Ka Nyasaye luongoi,In jaricho we bayoDipo kisik` e richo,Ret piyo.
Ndalo to kadho piyo,tho kod bura chiegini,Ringi idhi ir Yesu,Ret piyo,Akwayi ibed mariekdipo ndalo ong`adi,Kendo ilal mochwereRet piyo.
In jaricho winj duonde,yier Yesu mondo otelni,Eka jopolo nomor,Ret piyo,Ringi iae mudho,Bi ipuodhri ir Yesu,Yie ichak wuoth tinende,Ret piyo.

In Jakonya, Osiepa chutho,Mantie kodwa pile ka;Kik iwewa gi parruok,Ka wabedo e mudho;Ka yembe kudho matek,Chunywa bedo kod luoro;Luongwa, "Jawuoth, bi ira;Lu bang`a anatelni."
Ka tichwa oserumo,Wagombo yudo yueyo;Onge gi ma waritoMak mana polo kende;Onge gi ma wagenoTo mana remb Jawarwa;Luongwa, "Jawuoth, lu bang`a,Iniyud yueyo malo."
Yesu obiro ka kendo, Yesu ma notho Kalwari;Obiro omo jo moyie, Mondo gidhi polo.

Yesu `hera, En kodandalo duto e piny ka;Ka ahere nyak` obi,chieng` notera dalane.

Adwaro ng`eyo wach Yesu,Nokecha ka yandi nalal;Med puonja warruok man kuome,Kod tho nikech noheroa.

Chung` matek, gene,nomiyi loyo;Enoriti pilee piny marach;Kristo Ruoth kendemamiyi yueyoKa chandruokmar piny rumo.
Yesu, kar msalabani,Nitie soko maler,Aora machango tuo,Machwer a Kalwari.

Miya paro thoni, Ruoth,Kod rembi mochwerna;Konya bed buti pile,Ni mond` ichik wuodha.
Ruodha, mond asikiKanyo but msalaba,Kakiyo be kageno,Biro mari, Ruodha.
Nende aluoko lueta,Mondo gibed maler;Kendo giti niYesu saa duto tinende.
Onego aritraKwonde madhiye,Mond` ati ni Yesutich maber kende.

Ruoth Yesu noseng`iewowa gi rembe,Nyasaye osingoni jo moyie kuome,Kinde ma giruakoYesu e chunygiE ma enowenigiekethgi duto.
Osetimo tichnemadongo ni piny,Wamor moloyokuom puonj Yesu Ruodhwa;Wanamor moloyogi chunywa duto,Ka waneno wang`Yesu ma Jawarwa.
Muya Maler, winj alamwa.Mondo idag e chunywa;Gi tekoni duto ilor,Muya Maler, ibi.
Bi kaka ler! Mond` ifwenynwaKethwa, Kitwa maricho;Mond` itelnwa e yor ngima,En yor jo mabeyo.
Bi kaka mach, ipwodh chunywa,Kuom gik maricho duto;Mondo wachiwre ni Ruodhwa,Misango mangima.
Bi kaka koth, mi igwedhwa,Ka pod wan nyimi kae;Dak ipong`wa gi tekoni,Kiloyo chunywa chuth.
Kaka yamo mondo ibi,Gi teko kaka chon cha;Mondo warruok man kuom Yesu,Olandre piny duto.
E pinyno maber manyien,Nitie dala maler;Nosiki ma nyaka chieng`,Kendo mudho onge.
Nyasaye noyuwe pi wang`wa,Onge tho kata kuyo;Ok gikwan kata ndalo (ndalo),Nikech mudho onge.

An anadhi ka Yesu, En ma notho kuoma;Pile ageno Yesu, Lwandana mogeng`ona;Piny pod otimo mudho Ka pod awuotho kae;Piny to norum mapiyo, Eka nadhi kucha.
Mokwongo Ruodhwa Yesu,noketonwa Sabato;Kendo eka nowale,mogwedhogo ni dhano.
Wanamor ngang`,wanamor ngang`;Wamor nikech ndalono,en Sabato mar Ruodhwa.
Tich mar ndalowa rumo,Tinde chieng` maler mar Ruoth;Ka wadiro kuom chikne,Osingonwa gweth mare.
Polo gi piny, nokadhi,To Sabato ok norum;Wanadir e piny manyien,Nyaka chieng` ma nyaka chieng`.
Agombo bedo gi Ruodha,nikech agombo bet maler;En koluoka gi pi gi mach,nabed maler, nabed mapoth.
Ruodha, luoka abed maler;Chunya mondo obed mapoth;Kata kod mach niluok chunya,richona mond` orum chutho.
Kinyisa, kendo ipuonja,nabed mamor, nabed moil;Ka chunya ler, ka chunya poth,nabed mamor, mamor chutho.
Ka pod arem bedo maler,ok anyal ng`eyo puonj maber;Puonja, Muya Maler,Jahoch; Iluok chunya,abed mapoth.
Awuon e chunya, ee Ruodha,aseko kwerora matek,Ni mond` abed maler e Ruoth;To pok ayudo teko, Ruoth.
Nyasaye, gwedh Skundwa mar Sabato,Bedi Jatendwa, kwachokore;Tawa gi rieko gi herani,Kwaluwo yori.
Skund Sabato konyowa;Skund Sabato konyowa;Mondo wasom Wach Nyasaye pile,Ndalo duto te.
Chwo, to gi mon, gi nyithindo be;Chokore mond` giwinj Wachni;Muchi Maler obed JapuonjwaKwasomo Wachni.
Weche mwawinjo e Skundwa ka;Mi mondo gimoki e chunywa;Mondo wawuoth kuomgi e nyim ji;Kwaluwo ndachi.
E ndaloni maler mar RuothChunywa oyudo mor,Kwaweyo paro gik mag piny,Kwaparo wach Nyasaye.
En kinde maber mar lemo,Owenwa richowa;Wating`o dwondwa kwawacho,"Wuonwa manie polo."
Wamor kwawinjo weche kuwemoanwa ka Nyasaye,Wamedo padore kuome,Kwachiko yor polo.
Ka golo richo e chunywa,Otamowa nyalo,Nyasaye ong`eyo dwarowa,En to okonyowa.
Ang`eyo Yesu osewaraKuom herane gi ng`wonone;E nengo mochulo e thone,Omiya bedo nyathine.
Osewara!Yesu owara gi rembe;Osewara!Asebet nyathine chutho.
Amor nikech Ruoth osewara;Onge dhum ma dahul godo,Herano ma an go e chunya,ka koro Yesu dak koda.
Ageno neno Ruodha Yesu;E duong`ne gi berne duto;Otayo tienda e wang` yore,Oketo chikne e chunya.
E dala maler mar Nyasachwa;Osimb ngima oritoa;Chieng` moro kobiro gi duong`ne,Eka nabed kode polo.
Yesu oluongowakoro gi ng`wono,Oluongo in kod an be;Ochungo okoe dhoranga chunywa,Korito in kod an be.
Mondo ibi....ibi....Un jo mojony mond` ubi;Yesu oluongowa irekod ng`wono,Jaketh mond` ibi ira.
Yesu osayo,marang`o wadeko?Osayo in kod an be;Wadeko nang`okwachako ng`wonone?Ong`wonone kod an be.
Ndalo okadho,okadho mapiyo,Kadho ni in kod an be;Piny biro rumo,tho chikowa koro,Ochiko in kod an be.
Paruru hera maduong`ma osingo,mosingoni kod an be;Kata waketho,oyie wenwa kethwa,Oyie weni kod an be.
